item.title: Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Experience

Ireland

The Irish DMC who knows Ireland the best.

"After this group tour I do not want to cooperate with any other DMC worldwide any more – you are my heroes!"
– Paul, Tour Operator from Germany

Welcoming the World to Ireland for Over 60 Years

The Irish DMC who knows Ireland the best.

"I would like to express my sincere gratitude to you for creating such a wonderful, unique and memorable experience for me personally and for our group. I trust that without your professional efforts, ability and dedication we would never have such a great and successful trip."
~ Review from a Tour Operator in Dubai

Message from the CEO

"Welcome to the Ireland of Joe O’Reilly Ireland DMC, and a sincere thank you for taking the time to visit our website. We would love to be able to help you with your next trip to this wonderful Island of ours. If you need help with any aspect of your trip, please feel free to reach out to us. We'd love to hear from you!

Hopefully, we will have the opportunity of working with you and welcoming your guests to our shores soon." 

Bernard O'Reilly

Read about our founder, Joe O'Reilly

Our Partners

What Our Partners Say

"The Joe O’Reilly Group has been our DMC in Ireland for 17 years and we couldn’t ask for a better partner. The incredibly high levels of service and care that they provide – at every turn – makes us feel like we have our own offices (and own people) in Dublin and Cork. Problems are anticipated and solved with our guests’ well-being always at the forefront. Bernard, Ann, and everyone on the team there have been a pleasure to work with and we look forward to another great 17 years together!"
Bruce Epstein President, Odysseys Unlimited
“Thank you again for this last collaboration. Ireland is a fantastic country. All feedback from the participants were rave reviews. Thank you from me to all of your team, for their creativity, enthusiasm and resilience. This new success has brought us even closer to our customer. We will come back with other events.”
Damien Hurstel CEO, Good Story

On behalf of myself and the Travel With Bradley team I’d like to thank Joe O Reilly Ireland DMC for their professionalism.

This was their first time dealing with us and they did a wonderful job.   When they said they wanted everything to be perfect they succeeded.

The hospitality of their tourism partners also shined.   The staff at the resorts and restaurants were very accommodating and welcoming.

The quality of the coach was also very good.

This was truly a 5 star experience for Travel With Bradley passengers.

Bradley Walters President, Travel With Bradley

Our Ireland DMC Services

Group Tours of Ireland

See our full suite of Leisure Group Tours
View Our Group Tours

Golf Trips in Ireland

Tailor-made itineraries incorporating the finest golf courses
View Our Golf Services  

Rugby Group Trips

Start planning your Rugby Group Trip
View Our Rugby Services 

Equestrian Group Trips

Explore why Ireland is renowned as 'Home of the Horse'
View Our Equestrian Services 

M.I.C.E DMC in Ireland

Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events
View Our M.I.C.E Services  

Luxury F.I.T Ireland

Ultra luxury trips from our award-winning travel designers
View Our Luxury F.I.T Services

Active Retired Tours

We understand the unique requirements of Active Retired Group Travel
View Our A.R.T.I Services 

Special Interest Trips

For unique groups with particular requirements and interests
View Our Special Interest Services 

Our Itineraries deliver the Full Irish experience

Experience iconic sites with famous Irish hospitality

We make sure that your guests will see the best of what Ireland has to offer, and depart with enduring memories.

Irish music and dancing
Enjoy pints of Guinness and Irish Stew, served in a traditional Irish Pub
Experience unrivalled Irish wit from our local Tour Guides
Unique experiences, with exlusive access to venues and sites
Bespoke tours for niche audiences
 
Let's Chat

Creative & Unique Group Tours

Joe O’Reilly Ireland DMC delivers the highest quality of tour, price, and support of any Irish DMC.

The most creative itineraries
Experience the best of what Ireland has to offer
Tours of Ireland's iconic sites
Experienced Drivers & Tour Guides
Huge selection of additional Irish Experiences
 
View Our Group Tours

Your M.I.C.E DMC in Ireland

From complex corporate conferences, to unique incentive trips, Joe O'Reilly M.I.C.E Ireland is proud to deliver organisation and event management services to the highest international standards.

 
View Our M.I.C.E Services  

Your Golf DMC in Ireland

For 60+ years, Joe O’Reilly Ireland Golf have been at the forefront of organising golf tours in Ireland, none more so than for the Ryder Cup at the K Club in 2006 when we took care of the arrangements for Mr. Arnold Palmer and his entourage.

More than just golf, we wrap your trip in authentic and memorable Irish experiences, and offer plenty of activities for the non-Golfers on your trip.

View Our Golf Services  

Experience Luxury F.I.T in Ireland

Bespoke luxury trips in Ireland, managed by Ireland's leading travel designers.

Private Accommodation in Irish Castles & Estates
Private Tailored Tours of Irish Wonders
MIP (Most Important People) Packages
Authentic Irish Experiences
 
View Our Luxury F.I.T Services

Rugby Group Trips in Ireland

Let our rugby experts help plan your ultimate rugby experience in Ireland.

Experience Rugby the Irish Way
Access to tickets
Pre- and post-match hospitality packages
Pre- and post-match golf packages
Local activities, including musical pub crawls, food trails, whiskey tastings, and Guinness
 
View Our Rugby Services 

Active Retired Tours Ireland

Our attentive and friendly team understand the unique requirements of active retired group travel. We listen to your exact bespoke requirements, and manage every aspect of your senior citizens group travel, with a high level of personal service.

Half-day, full-day, and extended tours around Ireland
Special Interest trips, such as pilgrimages and shopping trips
Modern, comfortable, air-conditioned coaches
Smartly-dressed, helpful, experienced driver-guides
Fully managed and punctual service
 
View Our A.R.T.I Services 

High-End Luxury Equestrian Trips in Ireland

Joe O’Reilly Ireland Equestrian are privileged to announce our selection of creative, luxury equestrians trips to Ireland. Contact our Sales Department to receive a brochure.

Creative equestrian activities, exclusive to Joe O’Reilly Ireland Equestrian.
Bespoke trips, designed exlusively for your group.
Exclusive access and packages to Dublin Horse Show.
Private Tours of Irish Stud Farms.
Race Days with access to owners and trainers.
 
View Our Equestrian Services 

Special Interest Tours Ireland

From creative itinerary design, to managing all ground handling, our team are the experts to completely facilitate your group's visit to Ireland.

We work closely with you to make sure your group sees everything they want to see, on time, and within budget.

 
View Our Special Interest Services

item.title: Active Retirement Tours Ireland
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Coach Tours for Active Retirement Groups.

Our attentive and friendly team understand the unique requirements of active retired group travel. We listen to your exact bespoke requirements, and manage every aspect of your senior citizens group travel, with a high level of personal service.

Half-day, full-day, and extended tours around Ireland
Special Interest trips, such as pilgrimages and shopping trips
Modern, comfortable, air-conditioned coaches
Smartly-dressed, helpful, experienced drivers
Fully managed and punctual service
 
Click to Call Us

Sample Coach Tour Itinerary | 4 Days Galway & Connemara

Tour Route & Highlights

 Travel the Island of Ireland
Luxury Coach Throughout
Full Irish Breakfasts x3 Included

Explore Galway & Connemara | 4 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Depart for Galway Collection from your specified collection point.
Transfer to Galway for check-in to the 3-Star Salthill Hotel.
Dinner at the Hotel with live entertainment.
Day 2 | Exploring Connemara Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Full day tour of beautiful Connemara.
Free time in Clifden for a stroll and lunch.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey and Garden.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel.
Day 3 | The Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Full Tour of the Burren Region.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit the Cliffs of Moher & Visitor Centre.
Return to Hotel for dinner with live entertainment.
Day 4 | Departure Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart Galway for the journey home.

Coach Tours for Active Retirement Groups around Ireland.

With Joe O'Reilly Ireland, you're not just hiring a coach - we manage your whole trip, end to end, in a friendly and professional manner.

Explore your next coach trip in Ireland by calling our expert team, or telling us about your group via the form.

 
Click to Call Us

item.content:encoded:
Say hi! 👋

Any questions? We'd love to hear from you.

By Email  📧

Use the form on this page to send us an email. We're glued to our inboxes, so you should hear back from us super quick. Best for longer-form messages like RFPs, detailed requests, and similar.

Email: sales@jorireland.com

Call Us!  📞

Our Sales and Support teams are poised by the telephone, ready to take your call. We're a chatty bunch, so bring your best pub stories. Best for quick hellos and enquiries.

Tel: +353 181 20 200

item.title: Equestrian Tours Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your Equestrian DMC in Ireland.

For the equestrian enthusiast, Ireland offers the best experiences, from wild mountain trails to a gallop on some of our beautiful beaches, to experiencing horse racing on the Beach at Laytown – the only horse race approved on a beach by the World Horse Racing Authority.

Horse Racing
Horse Riding Holidays
Three-Day Eventing
Carriage Racing
Dublin Horse Show
 
Click to Call Us

Sample Itinerary | Equestrian Trip in Ireland

Tour Route & Highlights

 4x Full Days of Hunting
Stay in an Iconic Country Manor
Authentic Irish Evening Entertainment

Horse & Hound Trip– 7 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Surprise welcome for your group with a Bagpiper and a welcome whiskey.
Breakfast at your hotel.
Guided Tour of the seaside village of Howth.
Visit to Newgrange a cultural site from 3,200 BC.
Pre-Drinks in Clarke's Pub.
Dinner in Clarke's Pub.
Live show of traditional Irish music and dance.
Overnight at Hanover House, a unique period country house built in 1690.
Day 2 | Hunting Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart accommodation for the Hunt with Fingal Harriers Hunting Club.
Lunch at a local Irish pub.
Begin the hunt - 3.5 Hrs approx.
Soup and sandwiches at a traditional Irish pub.
Enjoy dinner at The Snailbox, a traditional Irish restaurant.
Return to accommodation and enjoy an evening of traditional Irish music.
Overnight at Mount Hanover House.
Day 3 | Hunting Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart accommodation for the Hunt with Tara Harriers Hunting Club.
Lunch at a local Irish pub.
Begin the hunt - 3.5 Hrs approx.
Soup and sandwiches at a traditional Irish pub.
Enjoy dinner at O'Brien's, a traditional Irish restaurant.
Return to accommodation.
Overnight at Mount Hanover House.
Day 4 | Exploring Dublin Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Guided Visit of the Guinness Storehouse.
Lunch at the Guinness Storehouse.
Visit to the Irish Emigration Museum.
Visit to Trinity College & The Book of Kells.
A Whiskey Blending Experience at the Irish Whiskey Museum.
A Night of Dog Racing and Dinner in Shelbourne Park.
After Dinner Drinks in Café en Seine.
Return to accommodation.
Overnight at Mount Hanover House.
Day 5 | Hunting Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart accommodation for the Hunt with Fingal Harriers Hunting Club.
Lunch at a local Irish pub.
Begin the hunt - 3.5 Hrs approx.
Soup and sandwiches at a traditional Irish pub.
Enjoy dinner in Man O’War, with an Irish Coffee Demonstration.
Return to accommodation.
Overnight at Mount Hanover House.
Day 6 | Hunting Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart accommodation for the Hunt with Oriel Farney Harriers.
Lunch at a local Irish pub.
Begin the hunt - 3.5 Hrs approx.
Soup and sandwiches at a traditional Irish pub.
Pre-Dinner Whiskey Tasting in Slane Distillery.
Enjoy dinner in Browne’s Bar in Slane Castle.
Return to accommodation for an evening of live traditional Irish music.
Overnight at Mount Hanover House.
Day 7 | Dublin & Departure Traditional Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Check Out & Coach Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

Request Our Equestrian Brochure

We've assembled hundreds of unique, creative ideas and itineraries for your equestrian trip to Ireland. For a copy of our Equestrian Brochure, just fill in the form.

Hey there - let's start planning your Golf Trip to Ireland!

We've assembled hundreds of unique, creative ideas and itineraries for your equestrian trip to Ireland. Tell us about your golf trip via the form.

Choose from dozens of inspiring links courses
Unique luxury accommodation
Additional Authentic Irish Experiences

item.title: Luxury FIT Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your DMC for Luxury & Ultra-Luxury F.I.T

Let our team of highly-experienced travel designers showcase Ireland's most curious and private excursions.

 Family and group celebrations
Unique adventures for thrill-seekers
Indulge in luxury culinary experiences
Specialty tours for niche interests
 
Click to Call Us

Sample Luxury FIT Itinerary

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explore the Wild Atlantic Way
Experience the Best of Ireland
5-Star Hotels, Castles & Manors

8 Days | The Luxury Tour of Ireland & The Wild Atlantic Way

Day 1 | Dublin & Welcome Arrival Dublin Airport to the care of your experienced Chauffeur–Guide, and enjoy a welcome shot of Irish Whiskey.
Visit to Trinity College, known for its treasures, in particular the famous Book of Kells, an illuminated manuscript of the 9th century.
Lunch in a traditional Dublin pub.
Visit to Guinness Storehouse, the home of Guinness Stout, the famous 'black stuff'.
Dinner at Dublin's famous Ivy Restaurant.
Overnight at the 5-Star Westin Hotel in Dublin City Centre.
Day 2 | Whiskey Secrets & Galway Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Your Self-Drive Car is delivered to your hotel.
Depart for County Galway, traversing the central plains of Ireland, East to West.
Connoisseur Experience at Kilbeggan Distillery, and discover how Irish whiskey is made since 1757 in a unique and exclusive ‘All Access’ tour with a whiskey expert.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Continue on to the famous village of Cong, County Mayo.
Dinner in Collins' Cottage at Ashford Castle.
Overnight at the 5-Star Ashford Castle Hotel, Cong.
Day 3 | The Magic of Connemara Full Irish Breakfast at the castle.
Full-Day Excursion of Connemara for its wild and rugged landscape of lakes and bogs, mountains and valleys, cliffs and beaches.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey & Gardens, the world-famous Bendictine Monastery.
Cruise on Killary Fjord, with lunch on board.
Visit to Connemara Oyster Farm with tasting.
Continue on to the famous village of Cong, County Mayo.
Dinner at Pat Cohan's Bar in Cong Village.
Overnight at the 5-Star Ashford Castle.
Day 4 | Ashford Castle Demesne Full Irish Breakfast at the castle.
Partake in Country Pursuits on Ashford Castle Estate – I.E falconry, fishing, horseriding, golf, and more.
Afternoon treatments at hotel spa.
Dinner in the George V Dining Room at Ashford Castle.
Overnight at the 5-Star Ashford Castle Hotel, Cong.
Day 5 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Irish Breakfast at the castle.
Full Day Exploration to The Burren and Cliffs of Moher.
Cruise - enjoy views of the incredible Cliffs of Moher from the Atlantic.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Bunratty Castle & Folk Park with tea / coffee and scones.
Dinner at The Oak Room Restaurant at the Manor.
Overnight at the 5-Star Adare Manor.
Day 6 | Dingle Peninsula Full Irish Breakfast at the manor.
Full Day Exploration of the Dingle Peninsula, a region renowned for its scenic coastal road along the Atlantic Ocean.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Irish Coffee Demonstration at a traditional Irish Pub.
Dinner at the The Carriage House in Adare Manor.
Overnight at the 5-Star Adare Manor.
Day 7 | Country Pursuits – Cashel Full Irish Breakfast at the manor.
Depart for Cashel.
Full Day to explore the activities, both indoor and outdoor, at Adare Manor. These include horse-drawn carriage ride, cycling, horse-riding, golf, and fishing.
Lunch at the clubhouse.
Visit to the Rock of Cashel.
Dinner at The Bishop's Buttery within Cashel Palace Manor.
Overnight at the brand new 5-Star Cashel Palace Manor.
Day 8 | Adare – Dublin – Depart Full Irish Breakfast at the manor.
Depart Adare towards Dublin Airport for departure flight.

Speak With A Travel Designer

Ultra-luxury Ireland, managed by Ireland's leading travel designers. 

World-Class Concierge Service
Tailored Tours of Irish Wonders
Creative Itineraries and Trails
Additional Authentic Irish Experiences

item.title: Rugby Trips to Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
• English
  • Français
  • English
  • Français

Start Planning Your Rugby Trip in Ireland.

 

Airport transfers via luxury coach included
Multi-lingual guide included
Stay in a 4-Star Hotel near the stadium
Full Irish Breakfast each morning
Match tickets with pre- and post-hospitality packages

Plan Your Rugby Trip With Us

Sample Rugby Trip To Ireland Itinerary

Rugby Trip to Ireland – 3 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport into the care of your guide.
Transfer by luxury coach to your City Centre hotel.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin City Centre.
Day 2 | Kick-Off! Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart for Aviva Stadium on foot to the match.
Kick-Off at 3pm.
Post-Match Meal at an Irish restaurant.
Evening Drinks in an Irish pub.
Overnight at your hotel in Dublin City Centre.
Day 3 | Shopping & Depart Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Free time in Dublin City for touring and shopping.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for your flight home.

Hey there - let's start planning your rugby trip to Ireland!

Allow us to help plan your ultimate Irish experience around Rugby.

Experience Rugby the Irish Way
Access to tickets
Pre- and post-match meal packages
Pre- and post-match drinks packages
Local activities, including musical pub crawls, food trails, whiskey tastings, and Guinness
 
Click to Call Us

item.title: Special Interest Tours DMC Ireland
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your Special Interest DMC in Ireland.

Every day, Joe O'Reilly Ireland helps unique groups with particular requirements to visit and tour Ireland. We help with large or fragile luggage, and with exclusive access to special venues. We dot the 'i's and cross the 't's. Whatever your special interest is, we will create an Irish experience around that.

Here are some of the most common group types we help:

 Faith Based Tours
Pilgrimages to Ireland
Musical groups, including choirs, bands, and orchestras
Adventure-seekers
Culinary Groups
Committee de l'entreprise
 
 
Click to Call Us

Sample Special Interest Tour Itinerary | Pilgrimage

Tour Route & Highlights

 Travel the Island of Ireland
Dive into Irish Culture & Legends
Walk in the Footsteps of St. Patrick

In the Footsteps of Saint Patrick – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Christchurch Cathedral.
Visit to St Patrick’s Cathedral.
Mass at St. Marys Pro-Cathedral
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Exploring the East Visit to the Hill of Tara.
Visit to the ruins of the Monasterboice Site.
Visit to the Old Mellifont Abbey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Mass at St Mel’s Cathedral in Longford.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 3 | Exploring Mayo Travel to Claremorris.
Visit Ballintubber Abbey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Free time to explore the Knock Basilica.
Mass at the Chapel of Apparition Knock.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 4 | Connemara Full Day Exploration of Connemara and the Burren Region.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey followed by Mass.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Cong and visit the ruins of Cong Abbey.
Travel to Lisdoonvarna passing through the Burren region.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 5 | The Cliffs of Moher Explore the Cliffs of Moher.
Travel to County Kerry.
Cross the Shannon Estuary from Killimer to Tarbert, County Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Dingle, County Kerry.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Mass in Tralee.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 6 | The Sites of Tipperary Travel to County Tipperary.
Explore the Rock of Cashel.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Holycross Abbey.
Visit to St Mary’s Cathedral in Kilkenny.
Mass en route.
Visit to St Canice’s Cathedral Kilkenny.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Carlow.
Day 7 | The Spirituality of Glendalough Travel to County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explorethe Glendalough Monastic Site.
Mass at Glendalough.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free timefor shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

Let us manage your Special Interest Tour in Ireland.

If you think you might need some help to organise and facilite your group's visit to Ireland, just let us know via the form. We love to chat!

item.title: Active Retirement Tours Ireland
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Circuits en

Autocar pour

Groupes Seniors et Retraités Actifs.

Notre sympathique équipe et professionnelle répond à toutes les
exigences de voyages en groupe des retraités actifs.Nous sommes à l'écoute de toutes demandes sur mesure, et nous nous occupons de réserver tous les services des voyages en groupe seniors, avec un service personnalisé de haute qualité.

Excursions d’une demi-journée, d’une journée complète et séjours prolongés en Irlande
Voyages de niche, tels que les pèlerinages et les escapades shopping
Des autocars modernes, confortables et climatisés
Chauffeurs expérimentés, serviables et à la présentation élégante
Service entièrement géré par nos soins et à la réponse ponctuelle
 
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler

Exemple d'Itinéraire de Circuit en Autocar | 4 Jours: Dublin et le Connemara

Itinéraire et les Temps Forts du voyage

 Travel the Island of Ireland
 Autocar de luxe du départ jusqu'à l'arrivée
 Petits Déjeuners Irlandais Inclus

Explorez Galway et le Connemara | Itinéraire de 4 Jours | 4 Day Itinerary

Jour 1 | Départ pour Galway Prise en charge à partir du point de rassemblement spécifié..
Transfert à Galway pour l'enregistrement à votre hôtel 3 étoiles à Salthill.
Dîner à l'hôtel avec soirée musique en direct.
Jour 2 | Explorez le Connemara Petit Déjeuner Irlandais à votre hôtel.
Journée complète d'excursion de la magnifique région du Connemara.
Temps libre à Clifdenpour une balade et déjeuner.
Visite de l'abbaye de Kylemore et ses Jardins.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel.
Jour 3 | Le Burren et les Falaises de Moher Petit Déjeuner Irlandais à votre hôtel.
Journée complète d'excursion de la région du Burren.
Déjeuner – en route.
Visite des falaises de Moher et de centre des visiteurs.
Retour à l'hôtel pour le dîner avec soirée musique en direct.
Jour 4 | Départ Petit Déjeuner Irlandais à votre hôtel.
Départ de Galway pour le voyage retour.

Circuits en Autocar pour Groupes Seniors et Retraités Actifs en Irlande.

Avec Joe O'Reilly Ireland, ce n'est pas seulement un transport en autocar - nous occupons de réserver l'ensemble de votre circuit, de A à Z, de manière amicale et professionnelle.

Préparer votre prochain voyage en autocar en Irlande en contactant par email ou téléphone notre équipe spécialisée, ou bien nous vous invitons à communiquer toutes les information relatives à votre voyage en remplissant notre formulaire.

 
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
 

 

Nous Contacter

 

Bureau de Dublin
Pour M.I.C.E, Rugby, F.I.T de Luxe, Équitation et Intérêts Spécifiques
Appel: +353 181 20 200
Email: mice@jorireland.com
Bureau de Cork
Pour les circuits de groupe,
Golf, et A.R.T.I
Appel: +353 214 385 700

item.content:encoded:
Bonjour à vous! Commençons à planifier votre séjour golf en Irlande!

Nous avons rassemblé des centaines d'idées et d'itinéraires uniques et créatifs pour votre voyage équestre en Irlande. Parlez-nous de votre séjour golf via le formulaire.

Choisissez parmi des dizaines de parcours de golf en bords de mer
 De superbes hébergements de luxe
 Des Expériences irlandaises authentiques supplémentaires
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
 
 

 

Nous Contacter

 

Bureau de Dublin
Pour M.I.C.E, Rugby, F.I.T de Luxe, Équitation et Intérêts Spécifiques
Appel: +353 181 20 200
Email: mice@jorireland.com

Pour les circuits de groupe,
Golf, et A.R.T.I

item.title: Equestrian Tours Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Votre DMC Équestre en Irlande

Pour les passionnés d'équitation, l'Irlande propose les meilleures expériences, en passant par des sentiers de montagnes sauvages, ou bien au galop sur de nos belles plages, mais aussi en assistant à des courses hippiques sur la plage de Laytown - la seule course de chevaux sur une plage approuvée par la World Horse Racing Authority.

Courses Hippiques
Vacances de randonnées à cheval
Évènement Hippique sur 3 jours
Courses de calèches
Dublin Horse Show : une compétition internationale d’équitation
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
 

Exemple d'itinéraire | Voyage Équestre en Irlande

Itinéraire et Temps Forts du voyage

 4 jours de Chasse
Séjournez dans un emblématique manoir de campagne
Soirée de divertissement typique irlandaise

Séjour Chasse & Equestre – Itinéraire de 7 jours

Jour 1 | Arrivée à Dublin Arrivé à l'Aéroport de Dublin, vous serez pris en charge par votre guide qui vous offrira un shot de whiskey Irlandais en guise de bienvenue.
Accueil surprise pour votre groupe par un joueur de cornemuse.
Petit déjeuner à votre hôtel.
Visite guidée du village de port de pêche de Howth.
Visite de Newgrange, un site archéologique de 3 200 avant J-C.
Cocktail au Clarke's Pub.
Dîner au Clarke's Pub.
Dîner Spectacle avec danses et musiques traditionnelles Irlandaises.
Nuit à Hanover House, une maison de campagne d'époque unique construite en 1690.
Jour 2 | Chasse Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Départ pour la chasse avec le club de chasse Fingal Harriers.
Déjeuner dans un pub irlandais local.
Début de la chasse - 3h30 environ.
Soupe et sandwichs dans un pub irlandais traditionnel.
Dînez au Snailbox, un restaurant irlandais traditionnel.
Retour à votre logement et profitez d'une soirée de musiques traditionnelles Irlandaises.
Nuit à Mount Hanover House.
Jour 3 | Chasse Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Départ pour la chasse avec le club de chasse Tara Harriers.
Déjeuner dans un pub irlandais local.
Début de la chasse - 3h30 environ.
Soupe et sandwichs dans un pub irlandais traditionnel.
Dînez chez O'Brien's, un restaurant irlandais traditionnel.
Retour à votre logement.
Nuit à Mount Hanover House.
Jour 4 | Explorer Dublin Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Visite guidée de la Guinness Storehouse.
Déjeuner à la brasserie Guinness.
Visite du musée EPIC lié à l'émigration irlandaise.
Visite de Trinity College & du livre de Kells.
Apprenez à fabriquer et à mélanger le whiskey au Irish Whiskey Museum
Diner et Soirée de courses de lévriers au Cynodrome de Shelbourne Park.
Après dîner, soirée avec boissons au Café en Seine.
Retour à votre logement.
Nuit à Mount Hanover House.
Jour 5 | Chasse Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Départ pour la chasse avec le club de chasse Fingal Harriers.
Déjeuner dans un pub irlandais local.
Début de la chasse - 3h30 environ.
Soupe et sandwichs dans un pub irlandais traditionnel.
Dîner au restaurant Man O'War, suivi d'une démonstration d'un Irish Coffee.
Retour à votre logement.
Nuit à Mount Hanover House.
Jour 6 | Chasse Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Départ pour la chasse avec le club de chasse Oriel Farney Harriers.
Déjeuner dans un pub irlandais local.
Début de la chasse - 3h30 environ.
Soupe et sandwichs dans un pub irlandais traditionnel.
Dégustation de whiskey avant votre dîner à la distillerie Slane.
Dîner au Browne's Bar à Slane Castle.
Retour à votre logement pour une soirée de musiques traditionnelles irlandaises.
Nuit à Mount Hanover House.
Jour 7 | Dublin & Départ Petit déjeuner irlandais traditionnel à votre hôtel.
Départ et transfert en autocar à l'aéroport de Dublin pour le départ.

Demandez Notre Brochure Équestre

Nous avons travaillé sur une sélection d'itinéraires uniques et créatifs pour vos voyages équestres en Irlande. Contactez notre service commercial pour recevoir une brochure en remplissant notre formulaire.

item.title: Luxury FIT Ireland DMC (FR)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Votre DMC Pour le Luxe et l'Ultra-Luxe F.I.T

Laissez notre équipe de concepteurs de voyages hautement expérimentés présenter les excursions les plus curieuses et privées d'Irlande.

 Fêtes de Famille et de Groupe
Des Aventures Uniques Pour Les Amateurs de Sensations Fortes
Offrez-vous des Expériences Culinaires de Luxe
Visites Spécialisées pour des Intérêts de Niche
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler

Exemple d'Itinéraire F.I.T de Luxe

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explorez le Wild Atlantic Way
Découvrez le Meilleur de l'Irlande
Hôtels 5 Étoiles, Châteaux & Manoirs

8 Jours | Le Circuit de Luxe de l'Irlande et le Wild Atlantic Way

Jour 1 | Dublin et Bienvenue Arrivée à l'aéroport de Dublin aux soins de votre chauffeur-guide expérimenté et profitez d'un verre de bienvenue de whisky irlandais.
Visite du Trinity College, connu pour ses trésors, notamment le célèbre Livre de Kells, un manuscrit enluminé du IXe siècle.
Déjeuner dans un pub traditionnel de Dublin.
Visite de la Guinness Storehouse, la maison de la Guinness Stout, et découvrez le fameux « Black Stuff ».
Dîner au célèbre Restaurant Ivy de Dublin.
Nuit à l'hôtel 5 étoiles Westin dans le centre-ville de Dublin.
Jour 2 | Secrets de Whisky et Galway Petit déjeuner irlandais complet à votre hôtel.
Votre voiture sans chauffeur est livrée à votre hôtel.
Départ pour le comté de Galway, traversant les plaines centrales d'Irlande, d'Est en Ouest.
Découverte la distillerie Kilbeggan avec un connaisseur et découvrez comment le whisky irlandais est fabriqué depuis 1757 dans une visite unique et exclusive « All Access » avec un expert en whisky.
Déjeuner en route.
Continuez jusqu'au célèbre village de Cong, dans le comté de Mayo.
Dîner au Collins' Cottage au Château d'Ashford.
Nuit à l'hôtel 5 étoiles Ashford Castle, Cong.
Jour 3 | La Magie du Connemara Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au château.
Excursion d'une journée au Connemara pour son paysage sauvage et accidenté de lacs et de tourbières, montagnes et vallées, falaises et plages.
Visite de l'Abbaye et des jardins de Kylemore, le monastère de Bendictine de renommée mondiale.
Croisière sur le fjord Killary, avec déjeuner à bord.
Visite de Connemara Oyster Farm avec dégustation.
Continuez jusqu'au célèbre village de Cong, dans le comté de Mayo.
Dîner au bar Pat Cohan dans le village de Cong.
Nuit au Château 5 étoiles d'Ashford.
Jour 4 | Domaine du Château d'Ashford Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au château.
Participez à des poursuites à la campagne sur le domaine du château d'Ashford - I.E. fauconnerie, pêche, équitation, golf, et plus encore.
Soins de l'après-midi au spa de l'hôtel.
Dîner dans la salle à manger George V du Château d'Ashford.
Nuit à l'hôtel 5 étoiles Ashford Castle, Cong.
Jour 5 | Burren et Falaises de Moher Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au château.
Journée complète d'exploration du Burren et des Falaises de Moher.
Croisière - admirez la vue sur les incroyables Falaises de Moher depuis l'Atlantique.
Déjeuner en route.
Visite du Château et du Parc Folklorique de Bunratty avec thé / café et scones.
Dîner au Restaurant Oak Room du Manoir.
Nuit au Manoir 5 étoiles d'Adare.
Jour 6 | Péninsule de Dingle Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au château.
Journée complète d'exploration de la péninsule de Dingle, une région réputée pour ses paysages côtiers pittoresques le long de l'océan Atlantique.
Déjeuner en route.
Visite de l'Oratoire Gallarus.
Démonstration d'une réalisation d'un café irlandais dans un pub irlandais traditionnel.
Dîner au Carriage House au Manoir Adare.
Nuit au Manoir 5 étoiles d'Adare.
Jour 7 | Promenade du Pays – Cashel Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au château.
Départ pour Cashel.
Journée complète pour explorer les activités, à la fois intérieures et extérieures, au Manoir Adare, incluant balade en calèche, vélo, équitation, golf et pêche.
Déjeuner du site monastique de Glendalough.
Visite du Rocher de Cashel.
Dîner au Bishop's Buttery au sein du Cashel Palace Manor.
Nuit au tout nouveau Cashel Palace Manor 5 étoiles.
Jour 8 | Adare – Dublin – Départ Petit déjeuner irlandais complet au manoir.
Départ d'Adare en direction de l'aéroport de Dublin pour le vol de départ.

Parlez Avec un Concepteur de Voyages

L'Irlande Ultra-Luxueuse, Gérée par les Principaux Concepteurs de Voyages Irlandais.

Service de Conciergerie de Classe Mondiale
Visites sur Mesure des Merveilles Irlandaises
Itinéraires et Sentiers Créatifs
Expériences Irlandaises Authentiques Supplémentaires

item.title: Rugby Trips to Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Commencez à Planifier Votre Voyage de Rugby en Irlande

 

Transferts aéroport en autocar de luxe inclus
Guide multilingue inclus
Séjournez dans un hôtel 4 étoiles près du stade
Petit-déjeuner irlandais complet chaque matin
Billets de match avec forfaits pré et post-hospitalité

Planifiez Votre Voyage de Rugby Avec Nous

Exemple d'Itinéraire | Voyage de Rugby en Irlande

Voyage de Rugby en Irlande – 3 Jour

Jour 1 | Arrivée à Dublin Arrivée à l'aéroport de Dublin sous la garde de votre guide.
Transfert en autocar de luxe jusqu'à votre hôtel du centre-ville.
Visite panoramique de Dublin.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel dans le centre-ville de Dublin.
Jour 2 | Coup d'envoi ! Petit déjeuner irlandais complet à votre hôtel.
Départ pour l'Aviva Stadium à pied pour le match.
Coup d'envoi à 15h.
Repas d'après-match dans un restaurant irlandais.
Boissons du soir dans un pub irlandais.
Nuit à votre hôtel dans le centre-ville de Dublin.
Jour 3 | Shopping et Départ Petit déjeuner irlandais complet à votre hôtel.
Temps libre dans la ville de Dublin pour visiter et faire du shopping.
Déjeuner dans un pub irlandais.
Transfert à l'aéroport de Dublin pour votre vol de retour.

Salut, commençons à planifier ton voyage de rugby en Irlande !

Permettez-nous de vous aider à planifier votre expérience irlandaise ultime autour du rugby.

Découvrez le rugby à la manière irlandaise
Accès aux billets
Forfaits repas d'avant et d'après-match
Forfaits boissons d'avant et d'après-match
Activités locales, y compris tournées musicales des pubs, sentiers gastronomiques, dégustations de whisky et Guinness
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
 
 

 

Nous Contacter

 

Bureau de Dublin
Pour M.I.C.E, Rugby, F.I.T de Luxe, Équitation et Intérêts Spécifiques
Appel: +353 181 20 200
Email: mice@jorireland.com

Golf, et A.R.T.I

item.title: Special Interest Tours DMC Ireland
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Votre DMC Pour Les Voyages d'Intérêt Spécial en Irlande.

Chaque jour, Joe O'Reilly Ireland aide des groupes uniques ayant des besoins particuliers à visiter et à faire le tour de l'Irlande. Nous vous aidons avec les éventuels bagages volumineux ou fragiles, et avec un accès exclusif à des lieux spéciaux. Nous accordons une importance capitale aux détails. Quel que soit votre intérêt particulier, nous créerons une expérience irlandaise autour de celui-ci.

Voici quelques-uns des types de groupes les plus courants que nous aidons :

Pèlerinages en Irlande
Groupes musicaux, y compris les choeurs, les bandes et les orchestres
Aventurier-ères
Groupes culinaires
Comité de l'entreprise
 
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
 

Exemple d'Itinéraire de Visite d'Intérêt Spécial | Pèlerinage

Itinéraire et Points Forts du Circuit

 Voyage sur l'île d'Irlande
Plongez Dans la Culture et les Légendes Irlandaises
Marchez sur les Traces de Saint-Patrick

Sur les Traces de Saint Patrick – Itinéraire de 8 Jours

Jour 1 | Arrivée à Dublin Arrivez à l'aéroport de Dublin, rencontrez votre guide expérimenté et escortez-vous jusqu'à votre autocar en attente.
Coup de bienvenue de whisky irlandais.
Déjeuner en route.
Visite de la cathédrale de Christchurch.
Visite de la cathédrale St Patrick.
Messe à la Pro-cathédrale Sainte-Marie
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Dublin.
Jour 2 | Explorer l'Est Visite de la Colline de Tara.
Visite des ruines du site de Monasterboice.
Visite de l'ancienne abbaye de Mellifont.
Déjeuner – apprécié en route.
Messe à la cathédrale St Mel de Longford.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Mayo.
Jour 3 | Explorer Mayo Voyage à Claremorris.
Visite de l'abbaye de Ballintubber.
Déjeuner en route.
Temps libre pour explorer la basilique de Knock.
Messe à la chapelle des Apparitions Knock.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Mayo.
Jour 4 | Connemara Journée Complète d'Exploration du Connemara et de la région du Burren.
Visite de l'Abbaye de Kylemore suivie de la messe.
Déjeuner en route.
Voyagez à Cong et visitez les ruines de l'abbaye de Cong.
Voyagez jusqu'à Lisdoonvarna en passant par la région du Burren.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Clare.
Jour 5 | Les Falaises de Moher Explorez les Falaises de Moher.
Voyage dans le Comté de Kerry.
Traversez l'estuaire du Shannon de Killimer à Tarbert, dans le comté de Kerry.
Déjeuner en route.
Voyage à Dingle, Comté de Kerry.
Visite de l'Oratoire Gallarus.
Messe à Tralee.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Kerry.
Jour 6 | Les Sites de Tipperary Voyagez jusqu'au comté de Tipperary.
Explorez le Rocher de Cashel.
Déjeuner en route.
Visite de l'Abbaye de Holycross.
Visite de la Cathédrale Sainte-Marie de Kilkenny.
Messe en route.
Visite de la cathédrale St Canice de Kilkenny.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Carlow.
Jour 7 | La Spiritualité de Glendalough Voyagez jusqu'au comté de Wicklow, connu sous le nom de « Jardin d'Irlande ».
Explorez le site monastique de Glendalough.
Messe à Glendalough.
Déjeuner en route.
Dîner et nuit à votre hôtel à Dublin.
Jour 8 | Shopping & Départ Temps libre pour faire du shopping à Dublin.
Transfert à l'aéroport de Dublin pour le départ.

Laissez-nous gérer votre Visite d'Intérêt Spécial en Irlande

Si vous pensez avoir besoin d'aide pour organiser et faciliter la visite de votre groupe en Irlande, faites-le nous savoir via le formulaire. Nous aimons discuter !

 

Nous Contacter

item.title: History of Ireland's DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ireland's DMC since 1966.

Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC is the longest-established independent, family-run, Destination Management Company in Ireland.

 

Read Our Company Story 
The Joe O’Reilly Group has been our DMC in Ireland for 17 years and we couldn’t ask for a better partner. The incredibly high levels of service and care that they provide – at every turn – makes us feel like we have our own offices (and own people) in Dublin and Cork. Problems are anticipated and solved with our guests’ well-being always at the forefront. Bernard, Ann, and everyone on the team there have been a pleasure to work with and we look forward to another great 17 years together!
Bruce Epstein President, Odysseys Unlimited

Celebrating 60+ Years in Business

As Ireland's longest running, independent, family-run DMC, nobody knows the island of Ireland better than us. With offices in Dublin and Cork, we deliver the highest quality of tour, price, and support of any Irish DMC.

Founded in 1966 by Joe O'Reilly (1932—2007), a visionary of Irish Tourism, JOR Ireland DMC is now headed up by his son Bernard. That makes us the longest established and most successful independent Destination Management Company on the island of Ireland.

Read about our founder, Joe O'Reilly

Our Partners

Message From Our CEO, Bernard O'Reilly

Hi There,

My name's Bernard, and I just want to thank you for taking the time to pop onto our site.

Personally, I’m really proud to share with you the legacy my father, Joe, created over 60 years ago. I hope the creativity and passion we stand for comes across on our site.

What we do is actually very simple – at the end of the day it’s all about listening, trust and people. We need you and you need us. However, we have to earn your confidence and trust; once you have this, you can rest assured that everything happens as it should with no surprises.

We become partners, so much so that we treat your business as if it were our own. It’s almost like you have your own local office here in Cork.

We’re very fortunate to have the fabulous people we have working with us, right across our two Offices, in Dublin and Cork. Some of my colleagues have over 30 years’ service – imagine the knowledge and experience that goes with that.

People are what makes this business, that’s why when you engage with us you end up working with same person on your project from the very start to the very end.

Another small point: we always place the same Drivers and Guides throughout the tour, with you from the moment they arrive until they depart. It’s these all these small little that make all our lives easier.

So, if you’re thinking of working with Ireland, I hope we’ve managed to convince you to at least give us a chance to work with you.

Some day you may have a specific idea in mind for a special itinerary, if so just lift the phone or email myself or indeed any of my colleagues. We can have a chat and draw up an itinerary that suits your needs. This way what you receive from us is exactly what you’re expecting. This we find also helps in cutting down on the turnaround time etc, plus we get to know each other better that little bit better!

Again, thanks for taking the time to visit,

Take care, and chat soon.

Bernard

Our Family of DMC Services

Since 1966, we've been welcoming group tours to Ireland from all over the world - and nobody knows Ireland better. Unlike other DMCs, we take the time to listen to and to work closely with you to assemble something really special for your guests.

The best Irish experiences from local guides, driven in luxury coaches, staying in well-situated hotels.

The best M.I.C.E partner in the best M.I.C.E destination on earth. For 60 years, we've been passionate about corporate events in Ireland and how we do them. We have a unique concept we call F.O.B.I.C. – Flexible, Original, Budget, Imagination. Creativity.

All of these elements combined ensure you end up with a truly a 'Wow' programme for your client and we are by your side all the way.

Where better in the world to plan your golf trip than the Island of Ireland, home to over one-third of all links courses in the world. And with us, you'll be in the care of the team that has managed Mr. Arnold Palmer's entourage during The Ryder Cup.

Why stop at golf? We offer the opportunity to build your trip around hundreds of authentic Irish experiences, including programmes for non-golfers. With us you can take in the local pub, learn how to make an Irish coffee. enjoy private tours of breweries and museums, and more.

We are fortunate to have here in Ireland some of the most spectacular and discerning properties, both private and public. This, coupled with our wonderful Irish hospitality and mind-blowing scenery, ensure your guests will be truly enchanted.

If you are looking for the ultra-luxury itinerary, you will not find better than JOR Luxury FIT to deliver this for you.

Since launching Ireland’s first International Horse Riding Academy in 1975, JOR Ireland has offered creative Equestrian itineraries, with unique activities not available from other operators.

Enjoy bespoke trips for both adult and family trips, tailored exclusively to your group.

Ireland has long been one of the great International Teams in the game of Rugby. Over the last 60+ years we as a company have forged and developed very close links with both the Irish Rugby Football Union and many local clubs.

Through these privileged contacts we are fortunate to have access to tickets and hospitality. We also cater to teams visiting from abroad, setting up fixtures, creating fun and engaging itineraries for your group.

A.R.T.I (Active Retired Tours Ireland) is a company we developed many years ago to cater to groups of people that are retired but still active. We have catered for hundreds of groups locally. We listen to what their interests are and deliver a tailor made itinerary ensuring that each and every request is catered for.

We pride ourselves on the wonderful driver guide we have that act as the tour leader for the duration of the tour.

Why Choose Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC?

Joe O’Reilly Ireland DMC delivers the highest quality of tour, price, and support of any Irish DMC.
60+ Years of Experience Ireland’s longest-established, independent, family-run DMC, covering the Island of Ireland.  
Dedicated Ireland-only DMC Covering the Island of Ireland, North and South, with offices in Dublin & Cork, nobody knows Ireland better than us.  
Local Knowledge Our local guides will teach your guests the lingo, and show them the best spots to capture lasting memories.  
All-Inclusive Tours

No surprise bills, no surprise stops – no surprises, period. One highly detailed invoice, and with no corners cut. 

  
Brilliant Staff

Multi-lingual, friendly staff that make your guests' time with in our company personable and warm.

  
One Driver / Guide

Your guests have the same driver / guide for the duration of their trip with us.

  
Warm and Personable Our highly personable team will ensure that your engagement with our office is both professional and friendly.  
Security via Guarantees Joe O’Reilly Ireland DMC is proud to have the highest credit rating available to any DMC in Ireland.  
24/7 Support

Should an issue arise, we are immediately contactable and guarantee a swift resolution.

item.title: History of Ireland's DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ireland's DMC SINCE 1966

Pictured: Founder and CEO Joe O'Reilly at a trade exhibition in 1966.

Read About Joe O'Reilly 

The Story of Ireland's DMC since 1966

Joe was a true pioneer of Irish Tourism. Having worked in the Car Hire business in both Ireland and the United States he came back to Ireland and formed his own company in 1966. He was the first ever DMC in Ireland, selling his wares at the time, mainly in the USA, United Kingdom and mainland Europe. He did this by attending international trade shows.

Over time Joe developed brands in the following sectors: DMC, Car hire, Horse Drawn Caravans, International Horse Riding Academy, Travel Agencies and a Tour Operator. In 1998, Joe’s son Bernard bought out the DMC side of the business from the family and went on to develop the Joe O’Reilly Ireland DMC brand with Offices in both Dublin and Cork, covering the Island of Ireland.

Read about our founder, Joe O'Reilly

History of Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC

View Image
1966 Joe O'Reilly Ireland Opens Its Doors

Joe O’Reilly Ireland opens its doors at Lancaster House, Lancaster Quay, Cork City.

 View Image
View Image
New Tours Horse-Drawn Caravan Tours Launch

 Joe O'Reilly designs and builds 50 horse-drawn caravans at Blarney and had 117 horses, catering to an international clientele interested in holidaying in Ireland at a much slower pace.

 

 View Image
View Image
Growing In Business Joe O'Reilly Car Rentals Launch

Seeing the demand for Ireland as a destination from his travels selling Ireland, he saw the demand for Car Hire and opened Joe O’Reilly Car Rentals.

 View Image
View Image
Rapid Growth International Sales

To garner up interest in the French market for his Horse drawn produce he took one of his caravans and horses to Paris and did a publicity stunt on the Champs-Élysées.

 View Image
View Image
1975 First International Horse Riding Academy in Blarney, Cork

Joe launched Ireland's first International Horse Riding Academy, headed up by Major Bill Ritchie, retired Chef d'Équipe of the English Army Equestrian Team.

 View Image
View Image
Welcoming the World to Ireland International Reputation

In the 80s and 90s, the M.I.C.E market was developing and we welcomed a German group from Hewlett Packard and held their Gala Dinner in an Irish Boarding School.

 View Image
View Image
1998 | Succession Bernard O'Reilly Becomes CEO

JOR Ireland DMC has a new CEO – Joe's son and protogé, Bernard O'Reilly.

 View Image
View Image
2006 Harley Davidson Festival in Ireland

JOR Ireland DMC, with Harley Davidson, hosts 4,500 bikers to a week of open rallies and events in Kerry, Ireland.

 View Image
View Image
2007 First "International Bike Week" Launched

JOR Ireland DMC creates and launches Ireland's inaugural "International Bike Week" – an annual festival of biking still celebrated every year.

 View Image
View Image
2006 Ryder Cup Working with Arnold Palmer

Joe O’Reilly Ireland Golf was to privileged work with Mr. Arnold Palmer on the Ryder Cup at the K Club in 2006. Pictured here with CEO Bernard O'Reilly.

 View Image

Speak With Our Expert Team

Lean on 60+ years of travel design and expertise in all things Ireland.

item.title: Joe O'Reilly (1932–2007)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Joe O'Reilly | 1932–2007

This page is dedicated to Joe O'Reilly, our Founder and a pioneer of Irish tourism.
1932–2007

Joe O'Reilly | Entrepreneur & Legend of Irish Tourism

The travel trade and Irish tourism has lost one of its most successful and colourful characters in the untimely passing of Joe O’Reilly.

An entrepreneur long before we knew the meaning of the word, he was one of the pioneers of Irish tourism. He travelled extensively in Britain and continental Europe promoting the country in the early 1950s – at a time when many Europeans confused Ireland with Iceland. Those with a knowledge of Ireland at that stage knew little more than its association with Eamonn De Valera, Arthur Guinness, the colour green, and that most of their inclement weather was caused by the winds that blew across the sea from Ireland. In the 1970s and 1980s Ireland became better known, unfortunately for the wrong reasons, as the northern ‘Troubles’ were widely reported.

It was against this background that people like Joe traversed the highways and byways, at times ploughing very lonely furrows and in the process laying the foundations of what is now one of our most important and successful industries. Later on he contributed at a strategic level as chairman of the Cork / Kerry tourism region.

Joe packed more into his 74 years than anyone I know. Leaving Cavan for the bright lights of Dublin and the car hire business, he quickly made his presence felt, both literally and metaphorically. With a loud hailer on the roof of his car blaring out the merits of his particular company, complaints of public nuisance were received by Garda authorities. He was eventually apprehended by one of those tall impressive Gardaí on point duty on O’Connell Bridge (traffic lights had not yet appeared). He quickly won him over, helped by the fact that they both came from the same neck of the woods - and thus began a 50-year friendship!

Ireland soon became too small to contain his exuberant talents. Like so many of his contemporaries, he took the emigrant ship to America but, unlike then, he had a First Class fare paid for him by a wealthy American who was enormously impressed with a holiday trip around Ireland that Joe had organised for him. With the aid of a borrowed suit, he was suitably dressed to dine at the Captain’s table - and in no time he became the top salesman for Avis in New York. 

On marrying Sheila, he returned to Ireland and set up a number of businesses, such as car hire, riding school, horse-drawn caravans, incoming and outgoing tourism. Through hard word, meticulous planning, innovation and a highly personalised approach, all were highly successful.

His innovative skills are best epitomised by his driving one of his horse-drawn caravans down the Champs Élysées in Paris, flanked by two gendarmes outriders. The event gained much sought after and invaluable publicity for Irish tourism because a photograph appeared the following morning on the front page of Le Monde, the prestigious French daily newspaper. At the time, Joe was the proud owner of 100 horses. How appropriate that he should in later years become a Knight in the equestrian order of Saint Sylvester.

He was also bestowed the honour of Knight of the Holy Sepulchre. These honours would in part relate to the tens of thousands of people for him he organised and led pilgrimages to Lourdes, Fatima and the Holy Land, and to his generosity to the church, both at home and on these missions. Indeed, his last flight was to Nigeria three months ago to celebrate the opening of a building named in his honour. It now houses 90 seminarians.

In his younger days, his extracurricular activities were also of note, involving as they did the escorting of the sex goddess Jayne Mansfield around the lakes of Killarney, on one occasion acting as musical accompanist to Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton, driving Gregory Peck around Dublin, and spending a night on the town with Dean Martin - not to mention various encounters with The Three Stooges. To balance things out, and with an eye to his final journey, he also managed to have breakfast with Pope John Paul II in his private apartments.No doubt he is now enjoying a four ball with three former members of the Joe O’Reilly Golfing Society (JORGS), two of whom were also doyens of the travel business, i.e. Martin Dully and Paddy Fitzpatrick.

Ar dheis De go raibh a anam dilis.

MD

This obituary was first published in the February 2007 Edition of Irish Trade Travel News

YOUR P.C.O & M.I.C.E DMC IN IRELAND

PCO (Professional Conference Organiser)
M.I.C.E (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events)
Speak With Our Planners

M.I.C.E & Professional Conference Organiser (PCO) Ireland

Our F.O.B.I.C Philosophy

Flexible, Originality, Budget, Imagination, Creativity – this philosophy informs every itinerary we design together with clients.

The word 'No' does not exist in our vocabulary.

Our M.I.C.E Services in Ireland

From complex corporate conferences, to unique incentive trips, Joe O'Reilly Ireland M.I.C.E is proud to deliver organisation and event management services to the highest international standards.

As your "MICE DMC in Ireland", we design and manage unique programmes for your guests. We craft special programmes for incentive groups, corporate groups, and events.

Planning a MICE event in Ireland?

Our team is ready to design and plan your perfect meeting, incentive trip, conference, or event.
Click to Call Us
Location, location, location

Why Choose Ireland for MICE?

Direct Access from All Over the World

With four main international airports on the island, we enjoy direct access from all main hubs worldwide. No matter where your employees are flying from, organising their transit to Ireland for your MICE event is frictionless.

Speak With Our Planners

 

Céad Míle Fáilte

Why Ireland is the Friendliest Country for MICE

Ireland has been voted the most friendly country in the world.

As your creative MICE DMC partner in Ireland, we ensure that your guests will have the opportunity to interact with the locals on a daily basis.

Some of the creative ways we can welcome your guests include:

A shot of welcome whiskey on arrival
Surprise bagpiper to guide you through the airport
More unique and creative ideas available upon request!
 
Speak With Our Planners

 

From Cottages to Castles

Luxury Accommodation in Ireland for MICE

Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE enjoys a deep, excellent working relationship with almost every 5-Star hotel on the Island of Ireland. Whatever experience you desire for your guests, we can organise.

If you require multiple accommodations, our organisers will handle the logistics of booking and transport so that everything "just works" for your guests. We aim to provide a seamless experience.

60+ years of practical wisdom
Unparalled luxury accommodation in Ireland
Unique activities for your guests
Additional creative Irish experiences
 
Speak With Our Planners
Spellbinding Entertainment

Captivating MICE Entertainment in Ireland

For big and small venues, Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE has access to an extensive list of performers, and we work with you to create a unique programme that will entertain and delight your guests.

Authentic Irish Cultural Performances
Traditional Irish Music Bands
Group Ceilí (Traditional) Dancing
U2 Tribute Band
Gospel Choirs
 
Speak With Our Planners
Your group, working together

Group Activities for MICE in Ireland

For corporate and leisure groups alike, Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC has access to hundreds of creative and unique group activities all across the Island of Ireland.

Play Irish Musical Instruments As A Band
Exciting Team-Building Away Days
Wildlife Activities, Including Falconry
Outdoors Activities, Including Sheep-Herding
Learn Irish Dancing
 
Speak With Our Planners
Fore!

World Class Golf for MICE in Ireland

Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE will provide your guests with the ultimate golf experience. With access to some of the world's most scenic golf courses - and many links courses - we ensure a memorable incentive trip.

50 of the Most Prestigious Courses in the World
Dozens of Special Links Courses Along Ireland's Coastline
Bespoke Golf Experiences For Your Group
Group Golf Clinics for Debutantes

Speak With Our Planners
Choose from the most impressive venues

Gala Dinner Venues for MICE in Ireland

Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE has access to an extensive selection of luxury gala dinner venues. For very large groups, the Guinness Storehouse, Dublin, can accommodate up to 2,000 guests across 5 stories.

Assitance With Menu Selection
Extensive Range of Menu Types

item.title: Golf DMC in Ireland
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Your Golf DMC in Ireland.

Tailor-made itineraries, playing at the best courses, wrapped in authentic Irish experiences — how does that sound?

Choose from 500 golf courses on the island of Ireland
Over 50 prestigious links courses
Daily Original Irish Experiences
Experienced Golfer Drivers & Guides
Irish Pubs, Breweries & Distilleries
Helicopters, Cars, MiniBus & Luxury Coaches
Luxury Accommodation, from Cottages to Castles

See A Sample Itinerary

Trusted By the Biggest Names in Golf

Joe O’Reilly Ireland Golf was privileged to be asked to manage all arrangements for Mr. Arnold Palmer and his entourage during the Ryder Cup at the K Club in 2006.

Pictured: CEO Bernard O'Reilly with Arnold Palmer, winner of 62 PGA Titles; and with Padraig Harrington, winner of the Open and PGA Championships.

Work With Us

Speak to a Sales Agent


Ann Corcoran
Sales Director
Call: +353 181 20 200
Email: acorcoran@jorireland.com

Sean Reilly
Sales Director, North America
Call: +1 913 401 58 24
Email: sreilly@jorireland.com

What We Manage

Unlimited Re-Drafting of Your Itinerary (Until It's Just Right)
Course Bookings With the Best Tee Times
Unique Irish Experiences Daily
Transportation, Experienced Golfer Driver-Guides
Dining Options, From Pubs To Award-Winning Restaurants
Accommodation, From Cottages To Castles
An Island Dedicated To Golf

Why Take Your Golf Trip to Ireland?

Only in Ireland can your crew sink a putt overlooked by a Viking tower, break for oysters, and spend the night in an 8th-Century castle.

As your Golf DMC in Ireland, we help you choose from over 500 great courses, and over 50 of the most polished links courses in the world. Then, we guide you through hundreds of authentic Irish experiences that infuse your tour with extra life and excitement.

Best of all, once we've built your ultimate tour together, Joe O'Reilly Ireland Golf manage your entire trip from start to finish — zero stress.

For a sample itinerary, check out our 6-Day Ultimate Irish Golf Trip.

Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

Choose From the Best

What Are The Best Golf Courses in Ireland?

Ireland boasts dozens of the most impressive golf courses in the world
— and 1/3 of all links courses in the world — dotted along our beautiful coastline.

Play Old Head Golf Links, Kinsale, a peninsula fashioned into a single incredible golf course. Or Royal County Down, ranked #1 by Golf Digest.

Whatever your budget and group size, we ensure that your group gets to play on some of the most picturesque golf courses in the world.

Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

From Cottages to Castles

Luxury Accommodation For Your Irish Golf Trip

Joe O'Reilly Ireland Golf enjoys access to almost hotel on the Island of Ireland, from 5-Star cosy cabins to luxury castles.

Wide selection of accommodation types, from cottages to castles
Full concierge service available
Private Dining Options
Whiskey Tasting & Irish Coffee-Making Demonstrations
Transportation (Helicopters, Vintage Cars, Etc)

Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

Authentic Irish Experiences

Additional Experiences For Your Golf Trip to Ireland

We help you wrap every golf trip to Ireland in exciting, memorable Irish experiences. Choose from hundreds of local experiences across the Island of Ireland.

Traditional Irish Pubs & Restaurants
Beer & Whiskey Tastings
Evening of Horse Racing / Dog Racing
Traditional Irish Evenings with Dinner, Song & Dance
Hiking, Fishing, and Cycling Adventures
Food Travels
Health & Spa Options
 
Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️
Authentic Irish Experiences

Activities For Non-Golfers On Your Trip

Spa Treatments at your hotel
Guided Visits to nearby gardens and castles
Culinary excursions in the local area
Irish Coffee-making demonstrations
 
Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

Sample Itinerary: 6-Day Ultimate Dublin-Based Golf Trip

Tour Route & Highlights

 Stay in the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel
 Play 5 Rounds of Golf
Evening of Greyhound Racing in Dublin
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival

Ultimate Irish Golf Trip – 6 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | The Island Golf Links, Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Surprise welcome for your group with a Bagpiper and a welcome whiskey.
Early lunch at the Island Golf Club Restaurant.
Round of Golf at the Island Golf Links Course.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Welcome cocktail on check-in.
Private Pub Crawl across 3 of Dublin’s finest traditional pubs, finishing with dinner, music, and dance at the famous Oliver St John Gogarty’s Pub in Temple Bar.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star City Centre Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 2 | Baltray Golf Links (County Louth) Round of Golf at Baltray Golf Links.
Late lunch at the Clubhouse Restaurant in Baltray, winner of the Best Golf Club restaurant in 2017.
Transfer back to Dublin City Centre.
Private Whiskey Workshop at the Old Jameson Distillery, and learn how to blend your very own Whiskey.
Evening of Dinner and Greyhound Racing at Shelbourne Park Greyhound Stadium, situated in the city centre, including a sponsored race and some betting tickets.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 3 | Palmer South Ryder Cup Course Round of Golf at the Palmer South Ryder Cup “Parkland Course” at the K Club Golf Resort.
Late lunch at Cliff at Lyons Orangery, close to the K Club, followed by an Irish Coffee making demonstration.
Transfer back into Dublin City Centre.
Guided Tour of the iconic Guinness Storehouse with a private connoisseur experience, and print your own photo souvenir on your pint of Guinness.
Dinner at Sophie's Restaurant, Dublin’s unique rooftop restaurant with a traditional cocktail served on arrival.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 4 | Druids Glen Golf Course Round of Golf at Druids Glen Golf “Parkland” Course.
Late lunch at the Delgany Pigeon House Restaurant.
Return to Dublin with a surprise “Musical Hitchhiker” en route, and a shot of whiskey!
Tour and recording of a piece of music accompanied by a musician in the private studios at Windmill Lane, famous thanks to the group U2.
Dine in Cleaver East, one of the best steakhouses in Dublin which is located in the U2-owned hotel in the heart of Temple Bar.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5* Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 5 | Old Portmarnock Links Course Round of Golf at the Old Portmarnock Links Course.
Late lunch in the little fishing village of Howth, at the Panoramic Seafood Restaurant Aqua, situated on the water. Oyster tasting with a Guinness on arrival.
Pub Games in a traditional Irish Pub.
Pre-dinner cocktail at the Horse Shoe Bar at hotel.
Farewell dinner in the private and iconic Constitution Room at the Shelbourne Hotel where the Constitution of Ireland was signed.
Afterparty at some of Dublin's top pubs beside the hotel.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5* Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 6 | Departure Free time in the city centre before transferring to Dublin Airport for departure.
Start Planning Your Golf Trip to Ireland

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

How We Manage Your Golf Trip to Ireland

As your Golf Tour Operator in Ireland, we manage and execute every facet of your trip to the highest international standard. Joe O'Reilly Ireland Golf provide the client with a creative, balanced itinerary that facilitates world-class courses, authentic Irish activities, and networking.

Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

Your Guest Experience
Visa Applications
Guest Registration
Luxury Accommodation
Social Events Programme
Golf Trip Planning
Course Exploration
Accommodation Selection
Transport Options
Culinary Choices
Transportation
All Local Transportation
Private Driver Options
Vehicle Selection
Helicopter Travel Available
Covid-19 Compliance
Full Compliance
Hand Sanitiser
Distanced Seating
Regular Checks

Let's plan your next golf trip together

Our team is ready to work with you to design and plan your next golf trip to Ireland.
Let's Plan Your Trip! 🏌️

item.title: Group Tours Ireland DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amazing Group Tours
from Ireland's DMC

All of Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC's tours are immersed in Irish culture. We make sure that your guests will see the best of what Ireland has to offer.

Click the button below to download our full brochure:

Request Our Group Tours Brochure

 

See our most popular tour
Plan a bespoke tour

See all City Breaks

See all 4 to 7 Day Group Tours

See all 8 to 10 Day Group Tours

Our Most Popular Group Tour

The Best of Ireland

Our 8-Day Flagship Tour

Your guests take in the best of Irish scenery, explore our most iconic sites, and enjoy exclusive access to unique and exciting Irish experiences.

Tour Ireland's Iconic Sites
Traditional Irish Pub Dinner, with Music and Dance
Experience the Wild Atlantic Way

item.content:encoded:
10 Day Tour
GRAND TOUR OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 The Complete Irish Experience
Enjoy Authentic Food & Drink in Irish Pubs
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Grand Tour of Ireland – 10 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Museum of Archaeology.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Travel To Belfast Travel to the Capital of Northern Ireland – Belfast.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Belfast.
Visit to the Titanic Experience.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 3 | Glens of Antrim Explore the Giant’s Causeway in County Antrim.
Travel to Derry.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Walking Tour of Derry.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the the Derry region.
Day 4 | Begin the Wild Atlantic Way Depart for Sligo passing via County Donegal.
Visitto the Glenveagh National Park & Castle, or the Megalithic Tombs at Carrowmore in County Sligo.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Stop at Ardara Tweed.
Visit to Belleek Pottery.
Travel to the town of Ballina, County Mayo.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the the Mayo region.
Day 5 | Connemara Travel to Galway passing via the scenic Connemara region.
Stop at the Ashleigh Falls.
Cruise on Killary Fjord or visit to Kylemore Abbey & Gardens.
Stop at Connemara Crystal in Moycullen.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the the Galway region.
Day 6 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Exploration of the Burren Region.
Stop at the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher.
Travel to County Kerry.
Cross the Shannon estuary from Killimer to Tarbert.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 7 | Dingle Full Day Tour of the Dingle Peninsula.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Stop at the ruins of Kilmakedar Church.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 8 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration of the Ring of Kerry.
Sheepdog Demonstration.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Stopat Moll’s Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit to Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Dinner & Overnight in your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 9 | Kerry to Wicklow Depart for County Wicklow, known as the ”Garden of Ireland”.
Lunch, enjoyed en route.
Stop at a Woollen Mill for some shopping.
Visit to the Glendalough Monastic Site
Travel to the Capital of the Republic of Ireland, Dublin.
Dinner & Overnight in your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 10 | Dublin & Departure Free Time for shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

9 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.content:encoded:
3 Days
BELFAST CITY BREAK

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Transfers with Tour Guide
3 Star Hotel, Belfast City Centre
2x Full Irish Breakfasts & 2x 3-Course Dinners
  • Location
  • Suggested Visits
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure
3 Day City Break – Belfast

Take In Belfast

Find adventure on foot in Belfast as you take in one of the most colorful and diverse cities in Ireland. From the tragic story of the ill-fated Titanic, to engrossing tours of the sites at the heart of Ireland’s sectarian conflict, Belfast has much to offer any cultural connoisseur.

City Centre Hotel in Belfast
Full Irish Breakfast Each Morning
Panoramic Tour Included
Peace Wall Tours
Crumlin Road Gaol
Tour the Titanic Experience
Explore the Ulster Museum
SS Nomadic

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

2 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
Transfers with English-Speaking Tour Guide
Half Board
2x Full Irish Breakfasts
2x 3-Course Dinners
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.content:encoded:
3 Days
CORK CITY BREAK

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Transfers with Tour Guide
3 Star Hotel, Cork City Centre
2x Full Irish Breakfasts & 2x 3-Course Dinners
  • Location
  • Suggested Visits
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure
3 Day City Break – Cork

Experience Irish Culture

In the street, in the gallery, and on the stage, Cork City has always been a home to explorers and thinkers, writers and poets, musicians and artists. As a European Capital of Culture, Cork City is filled with streets of warm Irish pubs serving unique Irish cuisine. During the day, pick up special souvenirs from one of the many artisan shops. For any cultural tourist, Cork should be your first port (city) of call.

Visit Kinsale
Visit Cobh
Tour the Titanic Experience
Tour Cork City Gaol
Taste the English Market
Explore Fota Wildlife Park
Explore Blackrock Castle
Lounge in an Irish Pub

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

2 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
Transfers with English-Speaking Tour Guide
Half Board
2x Full Irish Breakfasts
2x 3-Course Dinners
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

3 Days
DUBLIN CITY BREAK

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Transfers with Tour Guide
3 Star Hotel, Dublin City Centre
2x Full Irish Breakfasts & 2x 3-Course Dinners
  • Location
  • Suggested Visits
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure
3 Day City Break – Dublin

Dublin City Centre Break

3/4-Star centrally-located hotel, within walking distance of all attractions, including: Trinity College, Dublin Castle, The Convention Centre, 3 Arena and Grafton Street for shopping and more.

City Centre Hotel in Dublin
Explore Temple Bar
Full Irish Breakfast Each Morning
St. Patrick’s Cathedral
Trinity College & Book of Kells
Tour the Guinness Storehoure
Explore Howth Fishing Village
Newgrange Stone Age Site

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

2 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
Transfers with English-Speaking Tour Guide
Half Board
2x Full Irish Breakfasts
2x 3-Course Dinners
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.content:encoded:
3 Day Tour
DUBLIN & IRELAND'S ANCIENT EAST

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Experience the Book of Kells
Explore the Ruins at Glendalough
Pub Dinner with Irish Music & Dance
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Dublin & Ireland's Ancient East– 3 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival – Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Visit to Trinity College & the Book of Kells.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Ireland’s Ancient East Depart for Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explore the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Return to Dublin via the picturesque “Wicklow Gap”.
Pub Dinner & Show at Taylor’s Three Rock with traditional Irish Music & Dance.
Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 3 | Shopping & Depart Enjoy shopping in Dublin City.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure flight.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

2 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.title: 4 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
4 Day Tour
DISCOVER CORK & THE RING OF KERRY

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explore the Ring of Kerry
Experience the Wild Atlantic Way
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Discover Cork & The Ring of Kerry – 4 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival Cork & Welcome Arrive to Cork Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Depart for County Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 2 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration, of the Ring of Kerry, taking in the amazing scenery of the Wild Atlantic Way as you travel.
Sheepdog Demonstration with an authentic, Gaelic-speaking Irish sheep farmer.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Scenery – Take in the landscape of Molls Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Jaunting Car trip in Muckross Gardens.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 3 | Exploring Cork Travel to Blarney, County Cork.
Kiss the Blarney Stone at Blarney Castle & Gardens.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Travel to Cobh, Cork’s Harbour town, and the final port stop of the doomed Titanic.
Visit to the Titanic Exhibition.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Cork region.
Day 4 | Shopping & Departure Enjoy shopping in Cork City.
Transfer to Cork Airport for departure flight.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

3 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Dublin & the Splendour of Connemara – 4 Day Tour

Day 1 | Arrival – Dublin – Galway Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Depart for Galway, travelling across the Midlands.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Kilbeggan Whiskey Distillery.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Galway region.
Day 2 | Exploring Connemara Full Day Excursion of the Connemara Region.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Cruise on Killary Fjord.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey.
Free time in Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Galway region.
Day 3 | Galway to Dublin Depart for the Capital City – Dublin.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Afternoon free in Dublin City.
Pub Dinner & Show with traditional Irish Music & Dance, or evening of Dinner and Greyhound Racing.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 4 | Shopping & Departure Enjoy shopping in Dublin City.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure flight.
