item.title: 4 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
4 Day Tour
GAME OF THRONES EXPERIENCE

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Visit to Inch Abbey
Visit to Tollymore Forest
Visit to Winterfell Castle
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Game of Thrones Experience – 4 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival – Dublin – Belfast Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Depart for Belfast, travelling via the Boyne Valley.
Visit Tollymore Forest, film location for Game of Thrones.
Lunch in an Irish pub.
Visit the ruins of Inch Abbey.
Continue to Belfast City Capital of Northern Ireland.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 2 | Co. Antrim & Giant’s Causeway Full Day Tour of the North Antrim Coast.
Stop at Carnlough Harbour - film location for Game of Thrones.
Lunch in an Irish pub.
Visit Cushendun Caves - film location for Game of Thrones.
Visit to the Giant’s Causeway.
Stop at the Dark Hedges.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 3 | Belfast – Co. Down – Dublin Panoramic Tour of Belfast City and environs.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Visit to Winterfell Castle – film location for Game of Thrones.
Archery.
Depart for Dublin.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 4 | Dublin & Departure Panoramic Tour of Dublin via luxury coach.
Afternoon free for lunch and sightseeing or shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

3 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.title: 4 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
4 Day Tour
NORTHERN IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Travel the Glens of Antrim
Visit the Titanic Experience
Explore the Giant’s Causeway
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Northern Ireland – 4 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival – Dublin – Belfast Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Depart for Belfast – Capital City of Northern Ireland.
Lunch in an Irish pub.
Panoramic Tour of Belfast City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 2 | Exploring Belfast Visit to the Titanic Experience.
Lunch in an Irish pub.
Visit to the Ulster Museum.
Explore the Botanic Gardens.
Free time in the city centre of Belfast for shopping.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Belfast.
Day 3 | Giant’s Causeway & Antrim Coast Full Day Excursion of County Antrim.
Visit to the Giant’s Causeway.
Lunch at the Distillers Arms in Bushmills.
Visit to the Bushmills Distillery.
Return to Belfast via the magnificent Glens of Antrim.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Belfast.
Day 4 | Dublin & Departure Travel to Dublin, passing via the Boyne Valley.
Visit to the Monasterboice Monastic Site.
Free time for lunch – not included.
Continue to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

3 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

item.title: 5 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
5 Day Tour
DUBLIN & THE WILD ATLANTIC WAY

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Glendalough Monastic Site
Explore Connemara’s Natural Beauty
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Dublin & the Wild Atlantic Way – 5 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival – Dublin – Clare Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Depart for County Clare, travelling across the Midlands.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 2 | Exploring Connemara Full Day Exploration of the Connemara Region.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Kylemore Abbey & Gardens.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare.
Day 3 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Excursion of the Burren Region.
Visit to the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher and Visitor Centre.
Travel to Dublin via Limerick.
Panoramic Tour of the Irish Capital - Dublin.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 4 | Wicklow, The Garden of Ireland Depart for Co. Wicklow known as the Garden of Ireland.
Visit the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Visit to the Glendalough Visitor Centre.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Return to Dublin via the picturesque “Wicklow Gap”.
Pub Dinner with traditional Irish Music & Dance.
Overnight at your hotel in Dublin .
Day 5 | Dublin & Departure Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

4 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Pub Dinner with Irish Music & Dance
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.title: 5 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
5 Day Tour
THE TWO CAPITALS, DUBLIN & BELFAST

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Panoramic Tours of Dublin & Belfast
Full Irish Breakfasts Each Morning
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

The Two Capitals, Dublin & Belfast – 5 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Dublin, Ireland’s Capital Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Free Day in Dublin for shopping and touring.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 3 | Dublin to Belfast Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Depart for Belfast travelling via the Boyne Valley.
Panoramic Tour of Belfast – the Capital City of NI.
Afternoon free in Belfast for sightseeing and shopping.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 4 | Exploring Antrim Full Day Excursion of County Antrim.
Visit to the Giant’s Causeway.
Lunch at the Distillers Arms in Bushmills.
Visit to the Bushmills Distillery.
Return to Belfast via the magnificent Glens of Antrim.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 5 | Belfast & Departure Full Irish Breakfast at your hotel.
Transfer to Belfast Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

4 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Half Board
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.content:encoded:
6 Day Tour
ULTIMATE DUBLIN-BASED GOLF TRIP

REQUEST OUR FULL BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Stay in the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel
 Play 5 Rounds of Golf
Evening of Greyhound Racing in Dublin
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Ultimate Irish Golf Trip – 6 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | The Island Golf Links, Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Surprise welcome for your group with a Bagpiper and a welcome whiskey.
Early lunch at the Island Golf Club Restaurant.
Round of Golf at the Island Golf Links Course.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Welcome cocktail on check-in.
Private Pub Crawl across 3 of Dublin’s finest traditional pubs, finishing with dinner, music, and dance at the famous Oliver St John Gogarty’s Pub in Temple Bar.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star City Centre Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 2 | Baltray Golf Links (County Louth) Round of Golf at Baltray Golf Links.
Late lunch at the Clubhouse Restaurant in Baltray, winner of the Best Golf Club restaurant in 2017.
Transfer back to Dublin City Centre.
Private Whiskey Workshop at the Old Jameson Distillery, and learn how to blend your very own Whiskey.
Evening of Dinner and Greyhound Racing at Shelbourne Park Greyhound Stadium, situated in the city centre, including a sponsored race and some betting tickets.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 3 | Palmer South Ryder Cup Course Round of Golf at the Palmer South Ryder Cup “Parkland Course” at the K Club Golf Resort.
Late lunch at Cliff at Lyons Orangery, close to the K Club, followed by an Irish Coffee making demonstration.
Transfer back into Dublin City Centre.
Guided Tour of the iconic Guinness Storehouse with a private connoisseur experience, and print your own photo souvenir on your pint of Guinness.
Dinner at Sophie's Restaurant, Dublin’s unique rooftop restaurant with a traditional cocktail served on arrival.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 4 | Druids Glen Golf Course Round of Golf at Druids Glen Golf “Parkland” Course.
Late lunch at the Delgany Pigeon House Restaurant.
Return to Dublin with a surprise “Musical Hitchhiker” en route, and a shot of whiskey!
Tour and recording of a piece of music accompanied by a musician in the private studios at Windmill Lane, famous thanks to the group U2.
Dine in Cleaver East, one of the best steakhouses in Dublin which is located in the U2-owned hotel in the heart of Temple Bar.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5* Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 5 | Old Portmarnock Links Course Round of Golf at the Old Portmarnock Links Course.
Late lunch in the little fishing village of Howth, at the Panoramic Seafood Restaurant Aqua, situated on the water. Oyster tasting with a Guinness on arrival.
Pub Games in a traditional Irish Pub.
Pre-dinner cocktail at the Horse Shoe Bar at hotel.
Farewell dinner in the private and iconic Constitution Room at the Shelbourne Hotel where the Constitution of Ireland was signed.
Afterparty at some of Dublin's top pubs beside the hotel.
Overnight with Full Irish Breakfast at the 5* Shelbourne Hotel.
Day 6 | Departure Free time in the city centre before transferring to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

5 nights in the 5-Star Shelbourne Hotel.
5 Rounds of Golf (3 Links, 2 Parkland)
English-Speaking Tour Guide
All the unique experiences mentioned within the itinerary.
Luxury Coach
Full Board
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.title: 6 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
6 Day Tour
VIKING TOUR OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Experience the Best of Ireland
Explore Ireland’s Green Scenery
Tour Ireland’s Iconic Viking Sites
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Viking Tour of Ireland – 6 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive in County Cork Arrive to Cork Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Panoramic Tour of Cork City, one of Ireland's cultural hotspots, via luxury coach.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Cork.
Day 2 | Midleton, County Cork Explore the Jameson Distillery Midleton, where some of the best whiskey in the world is made.
Free time for exploration in the tourist town of Dungarvan.
Visit to Dungarvan Castle, an ancient viking site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Medieval Museum in Waterford.
Visit to the Crystal Museum Waterford.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Waterford .
Day 3 | Ireland’s Ancient East Train trip in the Suir Valley.
Visit to the Smithwicks Museum of Beer.
Visit the Dunbrody Famine Ship in New Ross.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Kennedy Park, original homestead of JFK.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Waterford.
Day 4 | Discover Wicklow Explore the impressive Kilkenny Castle.
Depart for Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Visit to the Gardens of Powerscourt House.
Explore the ruins at the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 5 | Exploring Dublin Panoramic Tour of Dublin City, founded by the Vikings.
Visit to the Christchurch Cathedral.
Visit to the National Museum of Archaeology.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Free time in Dublin city centre.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 6 | Shopping & Departure Free time in the city centre before transferring to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

5 nights in a 3*/4* Hotel.
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.title: 7 Day Tour
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
7 Day Tour
DISCOVER THE DELIGHTS OF IRELAND

Transportation Irish Ferries, using your own coach, arriving to Dublin

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Experience the Best of Ireland
Explore Ireland’s Green Scenery
Tour Ireland’s Iconic Celtic Sites
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Discover the Delights of Ireland – 7 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Dublin to Clare Arrival at Dublin Ferryport, and meet with your experienced Tour Guide.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin, capital of Ireland.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Depart for the West of Ireland, travelling across the Midlands.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare / Galway region.
Day 2 | Explore Connemara Full Day Exploration of the stunning Connemara Region.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Photo stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare / Galway region.
Day 3 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Exploration of the incredible Burren Region and the surrounding County Clare.
Visit to the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the Cliffs of Moher & the Visitor Centre.
Depart for County Kerry.
Ferry across the River Shannon.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 4 | Dingle Peninsula Full Day Exploration of the Dingle Peninsula.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the ruins of Kilmalkedar Church.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 5 | Ring of Kerry Full Day Excursion of the Ring of Kerry.
Sheepdog Demonstration with an authentic Gaelic-speaking Irish farmer.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Stop at Molls Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit to the Muckross Gardens, Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 6 | Exploring Wicklow Depart for Co. Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explore the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 7 | Shopping & Depart Enjoy shopping in Dublin City.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Transfer to Dublin Ferryport for Departure.

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
ARCHAEOLOGICAL & HERITAGE TOUR OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Discover Irish Heritage
Explore Ancient Villages
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Archaeological & Heritage Tour of Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Welcome to Ireland by Bagpiper.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Explore Meath Depart, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Visit to Newgrange stone age site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the iconic Hill of Tara.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 3 | Sligo & Mayo Travel to Sligo.
Explore the Neolithic Tombs at Loughcrew.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit the Carrowmore Megalithic Tombs.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 4 | Connemara Travel to County Galway passing via Connemara.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey & Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Return to Galway travelling through the Maam Valley.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Galway region.
Day 5 | The Aran Islands Depart by Ferry for Inis Mór – the largest of the Aran Islands.
Mini Bus tour of the island.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 6 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Visit to the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Visit the impressive Cliffs of Moher & the Visitor Centre.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Discover the site of the Grange Stone Circle.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 7 | Galway to Dublin Depart Galway for Dublin.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the National Museum.
Free time in Dublin City for lunch or shopping.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
THE BEST OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Tour Ireland's Iconic Sites
Experience the Wild Atlantic Way
Explore Ireland's Green Scenery
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

The Best of Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Exploring Galway Tour of St. Patrick’s Cathedral, Ireland’s Patron Saint, St. Patrick. 
Take in Ireland’s Hidden Heartlands, traversing the central plains of Ireland.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Walking Tour of Galway City, which was voted Ireland’s Friendliest City by Lonely Planet & European City of Culture 2020.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the  Galway region.
Day 3 | Experience Connemara Experience Connemara, for its wild and rugged landscape of lakes and bogs, mountains and valleys, cliffs and beaches.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey, the famous Bendictine Monastery. 
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare or Galway region.
Day 4 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Exploration, of the Burren.
Visit Poulnabrone Dolmen, the oldest megalithic monument in Ireland (4,200 BC).
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the towering Cliffs of Moher.
Sail Across the River Shannon, Ireland’s widest river.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 5 | Explore Dingle Peninsula Full Day Exploration, of the famous Dingle Peninsula, on the Wild Atlantic Way.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the medieval ruins of Kilmalkedar Church.
Visit the ancient Gallarus Oratory, 800BC.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration, of the stunning Ring of Kerry, home to surging waterfalls, rugged coasts, and brooding mountains.
Authentic Sheepdog Demonstration.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Scenic visit to Visit Moll’s Gap & Ladies’ View.
Tour Muckross Gardens in Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Cork region.
Day 7 | The Garden of Ireland Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Travel to County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explore the ancient ruins of Glendalough Monastic Site.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Travel to the Capital of the Republic of Ireland – Dublin.
Pub Dinner & Show with Traditional Irish Music & Dance or evening of Dinner and Greyhound Racing. 
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Enjoy shopping, in Dublin City.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure flight.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
BEST OF THE WILD ATLANTIC WAY

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Visit the Aran Islands
Explore the Ring of Kerry
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Best of the Wild Atlantic Way – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Shannon Arrive to Shannon Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to County Clare.
Explore Bunratty Castle and Folk Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 2 | Explore the Aran Islands Sail to Inis Mór – the largest of the Aran Islands.
Tour of the Island by mini bus on arrival.
Explore the ancient Dun Aonghasa Fort.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Return to Doolin in the late afternoon.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare region.
Day 3 | Exploring Connemara Full Day Exploration of the incredible landscape of Connemara.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Photo Stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Visit to the Leenane Sheep & Woollen Mill in Leenane.
Walking Tour of Galway City, Ireland’s cultural capital.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 4 | The Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Exploration of the Burren Region.
Visit to the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Explore the Cliffs of Moher.
Cruise around the Cliffs of Moher.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Sail across the Shannon Estuary from Killimer to Tarbert.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 5 | Dingle Peninsula Full Day Tour of the Dingle Peninsula.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Ruins of Kilmalkedar Church.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Irish Coffee in an Irish Pub
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration of the Ring of Kerry.
Sheepdog Demonstration with authentic Gaelic-speaking shepard.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Molls Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Jaunting Car Trip in the Killarney National Park.
Travel to Cork City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Cork.
Day 7 | Cork – Limerick Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Visit to Blarney Castle & Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Jameson Distillery.
Travel to Limerick.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Limerick.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping in Limerick.
Transfer to Shannon Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

Email: mice@jorireland.com

8 Day Tour
CASTLE TOUR OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Visit the Oldest Pub in Ireland
Dinner & Overnight in Ireland’s Castles
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Castle Tour of Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City's famous Georgian District.
Visit to the Guinness Storehouse, Trinity College, or St. Patrick’s Cathedral.
Travel North, via the Boyne Valley, to Kingscourt.
Dinner and Overnight at the 4–Star Cabra Castle in County Cavan.
Day 2 | Cavan to Galway Travel across the West of Ireland to Kilbeggan.
Visit Kilbeggan Distillery and Visitor Centre.
Travel through the central plains of Ireland to Athlone.
Irish coffee-making demonstration at Ireland’s oldest pub.
Walking Tour of Galway City – “City of the Tribes”.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Tour of the superb Connemara scenery in the afternoon.
Dinner and Overnight at 4–Star Ballinahinch Castle in County Galway.
Day 3 | Connemara Travel from Recess to Clifden and Letterfrack.
Tour an Oyster Farm, with tasting - see how oysters are grown over a three-year period from seed to plate.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey and Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Drive along the shores of Killary Harbour, Ireland’s only fjord.
Dinner and Overnight at 4–Star Ballinahinch Castle in County Galway.
Day 4 | The Cliffs of Moher Travel to Galway and visit Galway Cathedral.
Drive through the lunar-like landscape known as “The Burren”.
Visit to Doolin Cave, the longest free-hanging stalactite in Europe.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher & the Atlantic Edge Visitor Center.
Ferry across Shannon Estuary from Killimer to Tarbert.
Dinner and Overnight at Ballyseede Castle 4* in Tralee.
Day 5 | Dingle Peninsula Guided Tour of Ballyseede Castle.
Full Day Tour of the Dingle Peninsula.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Afternoon Cruise to Great Blasket Island (3Hrs) - Ventry Harbour to Great Blasket Island (no landing) and view the old deserted village, Trá Bán White Strand) and its seals.
Dinner and Overnight at Ballyseede Castle 4* in Tralee.
Day 6 | Ring of Kerry Full Day Excursion of the Ring of Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Tour Skellig Six 18 distillery & visitor experience – learn how their Irish Artisan Pot Still Gin is distilled, relax, and enjoy a gin and whiskey tasting experience.
Stroll through Killarney National Park and enjoy tea and scones at the Garden Restaurant at Muckross.
Dinner and Overnight at Ballyseede Castle 4* in Tralee.
Day 7 | Limerick & Dublin Travel towards County Limerick.
Visit to the picturesque little village of Adare.
Visit Bunratty Castle & Folk Park.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Continue to Kildare, famous for its horse-breeding industry.
Visit the famous Irish National Stud & Japanese Gardens.
Travel to Dublin.
Dinner and Overnight at the 4–Star Clontarf Castle. Whiskey Tasting after dinner.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
DISCOVER THE SPLENDOUR OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Discover Ireland’s Stunning Scenery
Explore Ancient Scenery & Ruins
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Discover the Splendour of Ireland

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Exploring Northern Ireland Travel to the Capital of Northern Ireland - Belfast.
Explore Trim Castle, the largest Anglo-Norman Castle in Ireland.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Belfast City.
Visit to the Titanic Experience.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Belfast.
Day 3 | Experience Belfast Visit to the Botanic Gardens Belfast.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Ulster Art & History Museum.
Free time in Belfast.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Belfast.
Day 4 | The Glens of Antrim Depart for the Glens of Antrim.
Visit to the Carrick-a-Rede Rope Bridge.
Visit to the Giant’s Causeway.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Bushmills Distillery.
Continue along the coastal route to Derry.
Photo stop at Dunluce Castle.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Derry.
Day 5 | Exploring Derry Walking Tour of Derry.
Visit to the Stone Fort of Grianan of Aileach.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Tour of the Inishowen Peninsula.
Visit to the “Doagh Famine Village”.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Letterkenny.
Day 6 | Donegal & Sligo Full Day Tour of County Donegal.
Visit to the Glenveagh National Park & Castle.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Belleek pottery.
Travel to Sligo, passing via the famous Glenties and Ardara.
Discover the town of Sligo.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Letterkenny.
Day 7 | Travel to Westmeath Visit to Foxford Tweed.
Travel to County Westmeath.
Explore Athlone Castle.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Kilbeggan Distillery.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
EXPERIENCE IRISH MUSIC, CULTURE & DANCE

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Discover Iconic Irish Pubs
Explore the Wild Atlantic Way
Experience Ireland’s Culture of Music
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Experience Irish Music, Culture & Dance – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Welcome to Ireland by Bagpiper.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Visit to the Phoenix Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Wicklow & Carlow Depart for County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Visit to Powerscourt House & Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Evening entertainment of Country Music & Dance.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Carlow.
Day 3 | Carlow to Kerry Visit to the Brú Ború exhibition “Sounds of History”.
Visit to the Rock of Cashel.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Tralee passing via Cork and Killarney.
Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Evening with Dinner at the Greyhound Stadium in Tralee.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 4 | Dingle Peninsula Full Day Exploration of the Dingle Peninsula.
Guided visit of an Old Irish Farm with Sheepdog Demonstration.
Lunch with entertainment of Traditional Irish Music and Dance in Dingle.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 5 | The Burren & Cliffs of Moher Travel to County Clare.
Visit to the Visitor Centre “The Music Makers of West Clare”.
Meet with a local Irish Traditional Musician.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher & Visitor Centre.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 6 | Exploring Connemara Full Day Exploration of the spectacular scenic Connemara.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Photo Stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Visit to the Sheep & Wool Centre in Leenane.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 7 | Galway to Dublin Travel to Dublin passing via the central plains of Ireland.
Visit one of the oldest pubs in Ireland.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Lullymore Heritage & Discovery Park inc Peat Bogs.
Evening of Dinner and Show with Irish Music & Dance.
Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
HIKING IN IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Creative Hiking Itineraries
Unique Trails and Scenery
All Hiking Levels Catered For
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Hiking in Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Walk through the Phoenix Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Hike in County Wicklow Hiking Trip to the Spinc and Glenealo Valley Trail in the Wicklow National Park (9.5Km, 3hrs, average difficulty).
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 3 | Travel to Galway Depart for Galway passing via the Midlands.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Cycling Tour of Galway city and the surrounding scenery.
Dinner and Overnight in your hotel in Galway.
Day 4 | Hike in County Mayo Hike Croagh Patrick, named after Ireland’s Patron Saint (7Km, 5hrs 30m, average difficulty).
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the charming Irish town of Westport.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 5 | Hike in County Clare Hike the Burren National Park and the Mullaghmore Loop (7.5Km, 3hrs, average difficulty).
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Hike along the Cliffs of Moher to Doolin village (8Km, 3hrs, average difficulty).
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 6 | Explore Killarney Travel to Killarney, in the Kingdom of Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Cruise on the Lakes of Killarney, departing from Ross Castle.
Explore and walk in the Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Killarney.
Day 7 | Hike in County Kerry Hike the Gap of Dunloe and Strickeen Mountain (7.5Km, 4Hrs, average difficulty).
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Portlaoise or Kildare.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

8 Day Tour
IN THE FOOTSTEPS OF SAINT PATRICK

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Travel the Island of Ireland
Dive into Irish Culture & Legends
Walk in the Footsteps of St. Patrick
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

In the Footsteps of Saint Patrick – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Christchurch Cathedral.
Visit to St Patrick’s Cathedral.
Mass at St. Marys Pro-Cathedral
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Exploring the East Visit to the Hill of Tara.
Visit to the ruins of the Monasterboice Site.
Visit to the Old Mellifont Abbey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Mass at St Mel’s Cathedral in Longford.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 3 | Exploring Mayo Travel to Claremorris.
Visit Ballintubber Abbey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Free time to explore the Knock Basilica.
Mass at the Chapel of Apparition Knock.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 4 | Connemara Full Day Exploration of Connemara and the Burren Region.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey followed by Mass.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Cong and visit the ruins of Cong Abbey.
Travel to Lisdoonvarna passing through the Burren region.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 5 | The Cliffs of Moher Explore the Cliffs of Moher.
Travel to County Kerry.
Cross the Shannon Estuary from Killimer to Tarbert, County Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Dingle, County Kerry.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Mass in Tralee.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 6 | The Sites of Tipperary Travel to County Tipperary.
Explore the Rock of Cashel.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Holycross Abbey.
Visit to St Mary’s Cathedral in Kilkenny.
Mass en route.
Visit to St Canice’s Cathedral Kilkenny.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Carlow.
Day 7 | The Spirituality of Glendalough Travel to County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explore the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Mass at Glendalough.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

8 Day Tour
IRELAND AND OUR CULINARY DELIGHTS

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 The Full Tour of Irish Culinary Tradition
Explore Farms & Artisan Workshops
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Ireland & Our Culinary Delights – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Travel to County Sligo, through the Central Plains of Ireland.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Sligo.
Day 2 | Western Tastes & Traditions Travel to County Mayo.
Tweed Demonstration at Foxford Woollen Mills.
Visit to Sheep & Wool Farm followed by a tasting of lamb.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore Achill Island.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Mayo.
Day 3 | Exploring Connemara Full Day Exploration of Connemara.
Teas & Scones, enjoyed en-route.
Photo stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Visit to an Oyster Farm.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Dan O’Hara Homestead, including a brown bread making demonstration.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Connemara.
Day 4 | Burren & The Cliffs of Moher Walking Tour of Galway City.
Visit to Burren Gold Cheese with tasting.
Visit to the Burren Smokehouse.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 5 | Exploring Kerry Travel to County Kerry and the Dingle Peninsula.
Cross the Shannon Estuary from Killimer to Tarbert.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Discover the Slea Head Drive.
Experience an Irish Coffee Demonstration in a pub.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Tour of the Ring of Kerry.
Visit to an Ice Cream Factory with tasting.
Salmon tasting with a glass of wine.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Seaweed Tasting along the Kerry coastline.
Visit to Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 7 | Irish Whiskey & Peat Depart for Dublin, travelling via Limerick.
Visit to the Kilbeggan Distillery.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Lyllymore Heritage Park and its peat bogs.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

8 Day Tour
IRELAND AND ITS HIDDEN HEARTLANDS

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explore the Rock of Cashel
Experience the Cliffs of Moher
Irish Dinners and Entertainment
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Ireland and its Hidden Heartlands – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Visit to the Phoenix Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Travel to Kilkenny Travel to County Kilkenny.
Visit to Kilkenny Castle.
Visit to the Smithwick’s Brewery.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the Rock of Cashel.
Travel to County Limerick
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Limerick.
Day 3 | The Cliffs & The Burren Explore Bunratty Castle & Folk Park.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher.
Travel through the Burren Region.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Limerick.
Day 4 | The Aran Islands Sail to Inis Mór – the largest of the Aran Islands.
Bus tour of the Island of Inis Mór.
Explore Dun Aonghasa Fort.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Return to Doolin by ferry in the late afternoon.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare region.
Day 5 | The Wild Atlantic Way Full Day Exploration of Connemara.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Photo Stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 6 | Cross-Country to Dublin Travel to County Meath, travelling via Athlone.
Visit to Lullymore Heritage Park.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore Trim Castle.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 7 | Exploring Dublin Visit to St Patrick’s Cathedral.
Visit to the Guinness Storehouse – pint of Guinness included.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Free time for some shopping.
Dinner and Show with Traditional Irish Music & Dance.
Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free timefor shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
IRELAND, NORTH & SOUTH

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explore the Giant’s Causeway
Journey to the Heart of Connemara
Visit the Impressive Cliffs of Moher
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

The Ireland, North & South – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Travel to Belfast Depart for Belfast, the Capital of Northern Ireland.
Panoramic Tour of Belfast City.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Titanic Experience Belfast.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Belfast region.
Day 3 | Touring Northern Ireland Explore the natural wonder of the Giant’s Causeway.
Visit the ruins of Dunluce Castle.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to Derry.
Visit to the Guildhall, the Town Hall in Derry.
Walking Tour of Derry.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Letterkenny.
Day 4 | Donegal & Mayo Depart for County Sligo travelling via Donegal.
Visit to the Glenveagh.
Visit National Park & Castle or Carrowmore Megalithic Site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Belleek Pottery.
Travel to Ballina in Co Mayo.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Mayo region.
Day 5 | Connemara Travel to County Galway passing via Connemara.
Option: Cruise on Killary Harbour or visit to Kylemore Abbey & Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Galway region.
Day 6 | The Burren & Cliffs of Moher Travel to County Kildare passing via the scenic Burren.
Visit the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Explore the Cliffs of Moher and Visitor Centre.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Depart for the capital of Ireland – Dublin.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 7 | The Garden of Ireland Depart for County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland“.
Visit to the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Powerscourt House & Gardens.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Departure Free time in Dublin City Centre for shopping and lunch.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
IRELAND'S BREWERIES, DISTILLERIES, AND PUBS

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Experience Unique Irish Whiskeys & Beers
Enjoy Food & Drink in Irish Pubs
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Ireland’s Distilleries, Breweries & Pubs

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Brewing in Dublin Learn To Pour Guinness at the Guinness Storehouse tour.
Visit to the Irish Whiskey Museum.
Travel to County Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Carlow / Kilkenny.
Day 3 | Waterford to Cork Discover the Smithwick’s Experience Kilkenny.
Travel to the coastal town of Dungarvan.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to County Cork.
Visit to the Jameson’s Distillery in Midleton.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Cork.
Day 4 | From Cork to Kerry Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Travel to Kerry via the scenic West Cork.
Demonstration and tasting of a shot of Poitín followed by Tea & Scones.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Moll’s Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit to the Killarney Brewing Company.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 5 | Exploring Dingle Full Day Exploration of the Dingle Peninsula.
Visit to the Dingle Distillery.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Discover the Slea Head Drive.
Travel to County Clare.
Cross the Shannon Estuary from Tarbert to Killimer
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 6 | Burren & the Cliffs of Moher Depart for the scenic Burren region of County Clare.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher.
Depart for Galway.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Walking Tour of Galway City with free time.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Athlone.
Day 7 | Athlone to Dublin Visit to the Kilbeggan Whiskey Distillery
2-Course Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Depart for Dublin City.
Free time for shopping.
Cocktail evening with 3 whiskeys or gins.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping in Dublin.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

Contact Us

item.title: 8 Day
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
IRELAND'S CASTLES, GARDENS, AND MANORS

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Explore Bunratty Castle
Experience Birr Castle & Gardens
Evening of Irish Food, Song & Dance
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Explore Ireland’s Gardens, Castles & Manors – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City.
Visit to the Botanic Gardens in Glasnevin.
Visit to the Phoenix Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 2 | Wicklow – The Garden of Ireland Travel to County Wicklow, known as the Garden of Ireland.
Explore the gardens of Powerscourt House.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Mount Usher Gardens.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kilkenny.
Day 3 | From Kilkenny to Cork Visit to Kilkenny Castle.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Rock of Cashel.
Visit to Cahir Castle.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Cork.
Day 4 | Gardens of Cork & Kerry Explore Blarney Castle & Guided Visit of the Gardens.
Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Travel to County Kerry.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Visit to Muckross House.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Kerry.
Day 5 | Gardens of Clare Travel to County Clare.
Explore Bunratty Castle & Folk Park.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the Cliffs of Moher.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 6 | Stunning Connemara Full Day Exploration of stunning Connemara.
Explore St Brigit’s Gardens.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to Kylemore Abbey & its Victorian Gardens.
Experience Killary Fjord.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Clare.
Day 7 | Castle Gardens Travel to County Offaly.
Visit the Gardens of Birr Castle, home of the 7th Earl of Rosse.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Gardens of Belvedere House.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
THE MAGIC OF IRELAND

Transportation Brittany Ferries, using your own coach, arriving to Cork.
REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Journey to the Heart of Connemara
Visit the Impressive Cliffs of Moher
Visit the Titanic Experience, Cobh
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

The Best of Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrival & Waterford Arrive at Cork Ferryport.
Travel to Cobh, Cork’s Harbour town, and the final port stop of the doomed Titanic.
Visit to the Titanic Centre
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Depart for Waterford, travelling via Midleton.
Visit to the Jameson Distillery.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Waterford.
Day 2 | Kilkenny, Wicklow, Dublin Walking Tour of Kilkenny.
Depart for Co Wicklow – “The Garden of Ireland”.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 3 | Experience Dublin Panoramic Tour of Dublin.
Depart for County Galway travelling through Ireland’s Hidden Heartlands.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare or Galway region.
Day 4 | Explore Connemara Full Day Exploration of Connemara.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Photo Stop at Kylemore Abbey.
Walking Tour of Galway City.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare region.
Day 5 | The Burren & Cliffs of Moher Full Day Exploration of the Burren Region.
Visit at the Poulnabrone Dolmen.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher & the Atlantic Edge Visitor Centre.
Travel to County Kerry.
Cross the River Shannon by ferry from Killimer to Tarbert.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Excursion of the Ring of Kerry.
Sheepdog Demonstration.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Stop at Molls Gap and Ladies’ View.
Visit to the Muckross Gardens in the Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 7 | Dingle Peninsula Full Day Excursion of the Dingle Peninsula.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit the Ruins of Kilmalkedar Church.
Visit to the Gallarus Oratory.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 8 | Tralee to Cork, and Depart Depart for Cork.
Panoramic Tour of Cork City.
Lunch.
Free time for shopping before transferring to Ringaskiddy for return ferry.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
SELF-DRIVE THE BEST OF IRELAND

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Tour Ireland's Iconic Sites
Experience the Wild Atlantic Way
Explore Ireland's Green Scenery
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Self-Drive The Best of Ireland – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport.
Collect your rental cars from Hertz at the Airport.
Optional with supplement: English Speaking Assistance at the Airport to help with car hire.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Exploring Galway Free time in Dublin to explore.
Suggested visits in Dublin available on request.
Depart for Galway, travelling across the Midlands.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Galway region.
Day 3 | Experience Connemara Full-day Exploration of the Connemara Region.
Suggested visits in the Galway area.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Galway.
Day 4 | Burren & Cliffs of Moher Explore the Burren before travelling to County Kerry.
Suggested visits in Clare and Limerick.
Explore the Cliffs of Moher.
Lunch in an Irish Pub.
Continue to County Kerry, travelling via Limerick, or by crossing the River Shannon by ferry from Killimer to Tarbert.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 5 | Explore Dingle Peninsula Full Day Exploration, of the famous Dingle Peninsula, on the Wild Atlantic Way.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore the medieval ruins of Kilmalkedar Church.
Visit the ancient Gallarus Oratory, 800BC.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration, of the stunning Ring of Kerry, home to surging waterfalls, rugged coasts, and brooding mountains.
Authentic Sheepdog Demonstration.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Scenic visit to Visit Moll’s Gap & Ladies’ View.
Tour Muckross Gardens in Killarney National Park.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Cork region.
Day 7 | The Garden of Ireland Free time in Cork City.
Stop at the Rock of Cashel before continuing to Co. Wicklow, known as the “Garden of Ireland”.
Explore the ancient ruins of Glendalough Monastic Site.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Suggested visits in Cork and Tipperary.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.
Return cars at the Airport.
English Speaking Assistance to help with returning cars.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
Half Board
Car Hire Based On 4 Pax Per Car
30+ Inspiring Tours

Get a copy of the full brochure

 

Looking for something more bespoke?

Contact our Sales Department, and we'll work together to design a tour your guests will remember forever.
Let's make something great!

item.content:encoded:
8 Day Tour
TOUR OF FAMOUS IRISH FILM LOCATIONS

REQUEST A BROCHURE

Tour Route & Highlights

 Harry Potter, Star Wars, and more
Experience the Wild Atlantic Way
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
  • Route
  • Itinerary
  • What's Included
  • Request Brochure

Tour of Famous Irish Film Locations – 8 Day Itinerary

Day 1 | Arrive to Dublin Arrive to Dublin Airport, meet with your experienced Tour Guide and escorted to your awaiting coach.
Welcome shot of Irish whiskey.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Panoramic Tour of Dublin City, film location of the film “ONCE”.
Discover Kilmainham Gaol – film location of “Paddington 2”.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Dublin region.
Day 2 | Wicklow & Wexford Travel to Wicklow, film location of “Braveheart” & “PS I love you”.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Explore ancient ruins at the Glendalough Monastic Site.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Wexford region.
Day 3 | Wexford & Kerry Discover the town of Enniscorthy, filming location of “Brooklyn”.
Walk on Curracloe Beach – location of the famous opening scene of “Saving Private Ryan”.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Travel to County Kerry.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 4 | The Ring of Kerry Full Day Exploration of the Ring of Kerry.
Visit Portmagee and discover the Skellig Visitor Centre, filming location for the latest “Star Wars” movies.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Boat Trip to Skellig Michael.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Kerry region.
Day 5 | Kerry & Clare Full Day Exploration of the Dingle Peninsula, strolling on Inch Beach, location of the film “Ryans Daughter”.
Free time to explore the charming town of Dingle.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit to the Cliffs of Moher, where Harry Potter and Dumbledore discover one of the Horcruxes.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare or Galway region.
Day 6 | The Ring of Kerry Full day Exploration of Connemara.
Stop in Oughterardand discover the Bridge, the beautiful film location of “The Quiet Man”.
Travel to Clifden, Leenane and Cong.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Visit the “White O’Morn Cottage Museum” from “The Quiet Man”.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in the Clare or Galway region.
Day 7 | Dublin to Meath Depart for County Meath, crossing the central plains of Ireland.
Explore Trim Castle – film location of “Braveheart”.
Lunch – enjoyed en route.
Free time in Dublin City.
Visit to the National Archaeology Museum.
Dinner and Overnight at your hotel in Dublin.
Day 8 | Shopping & Departure Free time for shopping.
Transfer to Dublin Airport for departure.

What's included in this tour?

Tour Includes

7 nights in a 3*/4* hotel
English-Speaking Tour Guide
Welcome Whiskey on Arrival
Luxury Coach
Full Board
Tea / Coffee with all meals
30+ Inspiring Tours

item.title: History of Ireland's DMC
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
DMC EN IRLANDE DEPUIS 1966

Sur la photo : le fondateur et PDG Joe O'Reilly lors d'une exposition commerciale en 1966.

EN SAVOIR PLUS SUR JOE O'REILLY

 

L'histoire du DMC irlandais depuis 1966

Joe était un véritable pionnier du tourisme irlandais. Après avoir travaillé dans le secteur de la location de voitures en Irlande et aux États-Unis, il est revenu en Irlande et a créé sa propre entreprise en 1966. Il a été le tout premier DMC en Irlande, vendant ses marchandises à l'époque, principalement aux États-Unis, Royaume-Uni et l'Europe continentale. Il l'a fait en participant à des salons internationaux.

Au fil du temps, Joe a développé des marques dans les secteurs suivants : DMC, location de voitures, caravanes tirées par des chevaux, Académie internationale d'équitation, agences de voyages et tour opérateur. En 1998, le fils de Joe, Bernard, a racheté le côté DMC de l'entreprise à la famille et a ensuite développé la marque Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC avec des bureaux à Dublin et à Cork, couvrant l'île d'Irlande.

Découvrez notre fondateur, Joe O'Reilly 

Histoire de Joe O'Reilly Irlande DMC

View Image
1966 Joe O'Reilly Ireland ouvre ses portes

Joe O'Reilly Ireland ouvre ses portes à Lancaster House, Lancaster Quay, Cork City.

 View Image
View Image
Nouveaux circuits Lancement des Circuits en Caravane Tirée par des Chevaux

 Joe O'Reilly conçoit et construit 50 caravanes tirées par des chevaux à Blarney et possédait 117 chevaux, s'adressant à une clientèle internationale intéressée par des vacances en Irlande à un rythme beaucoup plus lent.

 

 View Image
View Image
Croissance en Affaires Lancement de Joe O'Reilly Car Rentals

Voyant la demande pour l'Irlande comme destination de ses voyages vendant l'Irlande, il a vu la demande de location de voitures et a ouvert Joe O'Reilly Car Rentals.

 View Image
View Image
Croissance Rapide Ventes Internationales

Pour susciter l'intérêt du marché français pour ses produits tirés par des chevaux, il a emmené l'une de ses caravanes et chevaux à Paris et a fait un coup de publicité sur les Champs-Élysées.

 View Image
View Image
1975 Première Académie internationale d'équitation à Blarney, Cork

Joe a lancé la première International Horse Riding Academy d'Irlande, dirigée par le major Bill Ritchie, chef d'équipe à la retraite de l'équipe équestre de l'armée anglaise.

 View Image
View Image
Accueillir le monde en Irlande Réputation internationale

Dans les années 80 et 90, le marché M.I.C.E se développait et nous avons accueilli un groupe allemand de Hewlett Packard et organisé leur dîner de gala dans un pensionnat irlandais.

 View Image
View Image
1998 | Succession Bernard O'Reilly devient PDG

JOR Ireland DMC a un nouveau PDG – le fils et protégé de Joe, Bernard O'Reilly.

 View Image
View Image
2006 Festival Harley Davidson en Irlande

JOR Ireland DMC, avec Harley Davidson, accueille 4 500 motards pour une semaine de rallyes et d'événements ouverts à Kerry, en Irlande.

 View Image
View Image
2007 Lancement de la première "Semaine internationale du vélo"

JOR Ireland DMC crée et lance la première "International Bike Week" d'Irlande - un festival annuel du vélo toujours célébré chaque année.

 View Image
View Image
2006 Ryder Cup Travailler avec Arnold Palmer

Joe O'Reilly Ireland Golf a eu le privilège de travailler avec M. Arnold Palmer sur la Ryder Cup au K Club en 2006. Photographié ici avec le PDG Bernard O'Reilly.

 View Image

Parlez avec notre équipe d'experts

Appuyez-vous sur plus de 60 ans de conception de voyages et d'expertise dans tout ce qui concerne l'Irlande.
Discutons

item.title: Joe O'Reilly (1932–2007)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Joe O'Reilly | 1932–2007

Cette page est dédiée à Joe O'Reilly, notre fondateur et pionnier du tourisme irlandais.
1932–2007

Joe O'Reilly | Entrepreneur et Légende du Tourisme Irlandais

L'industrie du voyage et le tourisme irlandais ont perdu l'un de leurs plus grands succès et des personnages hauts en couleur lors du décès prématuré de Joe O'Reilly.

Un entrepreneur bien avant que nous connaissions le sens du mot, il fut l'un des pionniers du tourisme irlandais. Il a beaucoup voyagé en Grande-Bretagne et en Europe continentale pour promouvoir le pays au début des années 1950 – à une époque où de nombreux Européens confondaient l'Irlande avec l'Islande. Ceux qui connaissaient l'Irlande à ce stade en savaient à peine plus que son association avec Eamonn De Valera, Arthur Guinness, la couleur verte, et que la plupart de leurs intempéries étaient causées par les vents qui soufflaient sur la mer depuis l'Irlande. Dans les années 1970 et 1980, l'Irlande est devenue plus connue, malheureusement pour les mauvaises raisons, car les conflit du nord ont été largement rapportés.

C'est dans ce contexte que des gens comme Joe ont traversé les autoroutes et les routes secondaires, labourant parfois des sillons très solitaires et, ce faisant, jetant les bases de ce qui est maintenant l'une de nos industries les plus importantes et les plus prospères. Plus tard, il a contribué à un niveau stratégique en tant que président de la région touristique de Cork / Kerry.

Joe a fait ses bagages plus dans ses 74 ans que quiconque que je connaisse. En quittant Cavan pour les lumières vives de Dublin et le secteur de la location de voitures, il a rapidement fait sentir sa présence, à la fois littéralement et métaphoriquement. Avec un mégaphone sur le toit de sa voiture, faisant exploser les mérites de son entreprise, des plaintes pour nuisance publique ont été reçues par les autorités de la Garde. Il a finalement été appréhendé par l'un de ces grands et impressionnants Gardaí en poste le O'Connell Bridge (les feux de circulation n'étaient pas encore apparus). Il l'a rapidement conquis, aidé par le fait qu'ils viennent tous les deux de la même région - et c'est ainsi qu'a commencé une amitié de 50 ans !

L'Irlande devint bientôt trop petite pour contenir ses talents exubérants. Comme tant de ses contemporains, il emmena le navire des émigrants en Amérique mais, contrairement à l'époque, il avait un billet de première classe payé pour lui par un riche Américain qui était énormément impressionné par un voyage de vacances en Irlande que Joe avait organisé pour lui. A l'aide d'un costume emprunté, il était convenablement habillé pour dîner à la table du capitaine - et en un rien de temps, il est devenu le meilleur vendeur d'Avis à New York. 

En épousant Sheila, il est retourné en Irlande et a créé un certain nombre d'entreprises en location de voitures, centre équestre, caravanes hippomobiles, tourisme entrant et sortant. Par la parole dure, une planification méticuleuse, l'innovation et une approche hautement personnalisée, tous ont eu beaucoup de succès.

Ses talents d'innovateur sont parfaitement illustrés par le fait qu'il conduise l'une de ses caravanes tirées par des chevaux. les Champs Élysées à Paris, flanqué de deux gendarmes rôdeurs. L'événement a gagné une publicité très recherchée et inestimable pour le tourisme irlandais parce qu'une photo parut le lendemain matin à la une du Monde, le prestigieux quotidien français. À l'époque, Joe était l'heureux propriétaire de 100 chevaux. À quel point il devrait quelques années plus tard devenir chevalier dans l'ordre équestre de Saint Sylvestre.

Il a également reçu l'honneur de chevalier du Saint-Sépulcre. Ces honneurs seraient en partie liés aux dizaines de milliers de personnes dont il a organisé et conduit des pèlerinages à Lourdes, Fatima et en Terre Sainte, mais aussi à sa générosité envers l'église, à la maison et sur ces missions. En effet, son dernier vol était vers le Nigeria trois mois avant cela pour célébrer l'ouverture d'un bâtiment nommé en son honneur. Il abrite aujourd'hui 90 séminaristes.

De plus, ses activités étaient tout aussi importantes dans sa jeunesse, comme escorter la déesse du sexe Jayne Mansfield autour des lacs de Killarney, ou en tant qu'accompagnateur musical d'Elizabeth Taylor et Richard Burton. Il a également conduit Gregory Peck à travers Dublin et a passé une nuit en ville avec Dean Martin, sans parler de diverses rencontres avec The Three Stooges. Pour équilibrer le tout, et en vue de son dernier voyage, il a également réussi à prendre le petit-déjeuner avec le Pape Jean-Paul II dans ses appartements privés. Il ne fait aucun doute qu'il joue maintenant un quatre balles avec trois anciens membres de la Joe O'Reilly Golfing Society (JORGS), dont deux étaient également des doyens de l'industrie du voyage, à savoir Martin Dully et Paddy Fitzpatrick.

Ar dheis De go raibh a anam dilis.

MD

Cette histoire a été publiée pour la première fois dans l'édition de février 2007 de Irish Trade Travel News.

item.content:encoded:
VOTRE P.C.O & M.I.C.E DMC EN IRLANDE

PCO (Professional Conference Organiser)
M.I.C.E (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events)
Parlez avec nos organisateurs

M.I.C.E et organisateur professionnel de conférences (PCO) Irlande

Notre philosophie F.O.B.I.C

Flexible, Originality, Budget, Imagination, Creativity, cette philosophie informe chaque itinéraire que nous concevons avec nos clients.

'Non' ne fais pas partie de notre vocabulaire.

Nos services M.I.C.E en Irlande

Des conférences d'entreprise aux voyages incentive ou voyages de récompenses, Joe O'Reilly Ireland M.I.C.E est fier de fournir des services d'organisation et de gestion d'événements aux normes internationales les plus élevées.

En tant que "MICE DMC en Irlande", nous concevons et gérons des programmes uniques pour vos invités.

TABLE OF CONTENTS
loading...
TOUCH
Pourquoi l'Irlande est imbattable en terme de MICE
Pourquoi l'Irlande est imbattable en terme de MICE Lire la suite
TOUCH
Pourquoi l'Irlande est le pays le plus convivial pour le MICE
Pourquoi l'Irlande est le pays le plus convivial pour le MICE Lire la suite
TOUCH
Hébergement de luxe pour MICE en Irlande
Hébergement de luxe pour MICE en Irlande Lire la suite
TOUCH
Divertissement pour MICE en Irlande
Divertissement pour MICE en Irlande Lire la suite
TOUCH
Activités de groupe pour MICE en Irlande
Activités de groupe pour MICE en Irlande Lire la suite
TOUCH
World Class Golf for MICE in Ireland
World Class Golf for MICE in Ireland Lire la suite
TOUCH
Gala Dinners for MICE in Ireland
Gala Dinners for MICE in Ireland Read More
TOUCH
Conference Management for MICE in Ireland
Conference Management for MICE in Ireland Read More

Vous planifiez un événement MICE en Irlande?

Notre équipe est prête à parfaitement concevoir et planifier vos réunions, voyages incentive, conférences ou événements.
Cliquez Pour Nous Appeler
Emplacement, emplacement, emplacement

Pourquoi choisir l'Irlande pour le MICE?

Accès direct depuis le monde entier

Avec quatre aéroports internationaux sur notre île, nous bénéficions d'un accès direct depuis tous les principaux hubs du monde entier. Peu importe d'où viennent votre équipe, leur voyage vers l'Irlande pour votre événement MICE se fera sans aucun problème

Parlez avec nos organisateurs

 

Céad Míle Fáilte

Pourquoi l'Irlande est le pays le plus convivial pour le MICE

L'Irlande a été élue pays le plus amical du monde.

En tant que partenaire créatif MICE DMC en Irlande, nous veillons à ce que vos invités aient la possibilité d'interagir quotidiennement avec les habitants.

Voici quelques-unes des façons créatives dont nous pouvons accueillir vos invités:

 Un shot de whisky de bienvenue à l'arrivée
 Accueil en musique avec Cornemuse pour vous guider à travers l'aéroport
 Plus d'idées uniques et créatives disponibles sur demande!
 
 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs

 

Des chalets aux châteaux

Hébergement de luxe en Irlande pour du MICE

Joe O'Reilly Irlande MICE entretient d'excellentes relations de travail avec presque tous les hôtels 5 étoiles de l'île d'Irlande. Quelle que soit l'expérience que vous désirez pour vos invités, nous pouvons l'organiser.

Si vous avez besoin de plusieurs hébergements, nos organisateurs s'occuperont de la logistique de réservation et de transport afin que tout "fonctionne" pour vos invités. Nous visons à fournir une expérience transparente.

 Plus de 60 ans de pratique dans la sagesse
Hébergement de luxe inégalé en Irlande
Des activités uniques pour vos invités
Expériences irlandaises créatives supplémentaires
 
 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs
Divertissement

Divertissement MICE captivant en Irlande

Pour les grandes et les petites salles, Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE a accès à une longue liste d'artistes, et nous travaillons avec vous pour créer un programme unique qui divertira et ravira vos invités.

Des performances culturelles irlandaises authentiques
Groupes de musique irlandaise traditionnelle
Danse de groupe Ceilí (traditionnelle)
Groupe hommage à U2
 Chorales de Gospel
 
 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs
Votre groupe, travailler ensemble

Activités de groupe pour MICE en Irlande

Pour les groupes d'affaires et de loisirs, Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC a accès à des centaines d'activités de groupe créatives et uniques dans toute l'île d'Irlande.

 Essayez des instruments de musique irlandais en groupe
Des journées passionantes de renforcement d'équipe
Activités fauniques, y compris la fauconnerie
Activités de plein air, y compris l'élevage de moutons
 Apprendre la danse irlandaise
 
 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs
Fore!

Golf de classe mondiale pour MICE en Irlande

Joe O'Reilly Ireland MICE offrira à vos invités une expérience de golf ultime. Avec l'accès à certains des parcours de golf les plus pittoresques du monde - et à de nombreux parcours links - nous vous garantissons un voyage incentive mémorable.

 50 des cours les plus prestigieux au monde
Des dizaines de parcours de liaisons spéciales le long de la côte irlandaise
Expériences de golf sur mesure pour votre groupe
Cliniques de golf en groupe pour débutants

 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs
Choisissez parmi les lieux les plus impressionnants

Lieux de dîner de gala pour le MICE en Irlande

Joe O'Reilly Irlande MICE a accès à une vaste sélection de lieux de dîner de gala de luxe. Pour les très grands groupes, le Guinness Storehouse, Dublin, peut accueillir jusqu'à 2 000 invités sur 5 étages.

 Assistance avec sélection de menu
Vaste gamme de types de menus
Gestion de la santé et de la sécurité
 
 
Parlez avec nos organisateurs
Nous avons préparé le terrain pour vous

Gestion de conférence en Irlande pour MICE

En tant qu'organisateur professionnel de votre conférence, nous gérons et exécutons chaque facette de votre conférence selon les normes internationales les plus élevées. Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC fournit au client un itinéraire créatif et équilibré qui facilite les réunions d'affaires, les activités incentive le réseautage et les activités sociales.

 

Parlez avec nos organisateurs

item.title: Covid-19 Safety Protocol
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
NOTRE PROTOCOLE DE SÉCURITÉ COVID-19

Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC adhère étroitement, sur tous les aspects de nos opérations et de nos circuits, aux directives et mesures sanitaires énoncées par le gouvernement irlandais pour lutter contre la propagation du Covid-19.

Notre protocole Covid-19 complet est disponible sur demande.

Veuillez envoyer un e-mail à notre responsable sécurité Covid à safety@jorireland.com pour recevoir une copie de notre protocole de sécurité Covid-19.

Joe O'Reilly Ireland DMC est fier d'accueillir vos invités dans un environnement sûr pour explorer et profiter de l'Irlande.

NOUS ADHÉRONS STRICTEMENT À TOUTES LES RECOMMANDATIONS DE SANTÉ PUBLIQUE SUR LES DIRECTIVES D'HYGIÉNE PUBLIQUE ET DE SÉCURITÉ POUR COVID-19
TOUS NOS FOURNISSEURS SONT INSCRITS À NOTRE PROTOCOLE COVID POUR LA SÉCURITÉ DE VOS INVITÉS.
TOUS NOS DIRECTEURS DE CIRCUITS / GUIDES ETCHAUFFEURS SONT COMPLÈTEMENT VACCINÉS.

La Charte de sécurité Covid-19 est approuvée par Fáilte Ireland et le gouvernement irlandais.
